# VOLUNTEERS NEEDED
# FOR FINAL PUSH
# BEFORE THE PRIMARY ELECTION
---
|
# SIGN WAVING
---
| **Show people your enthusiasm for Kim George and help her get some publicity! We will be standing on street corners waving Kim George For Congress signs and distributing palm cards.****What you can bring: your American flags, water, sun screen, and a friend or two.**
---
| **Join us!**
Monday, 22nd, 7-8:30am: **Bell Rd. & 7th Street**. Park behind Chase Bank on the SE corner.
Tuesday, 23rd, 7-8:30am: **Shea & 92nd**. Park near McDonalds on the SE corner.
Wednesday, 24th, 7-8:30am: **Tatum & Cactus**. Park near Comerica Bank on the SE corner.
Thursday, 25th, 7-8:30 am: **Scottsdale & Pinnacle Peak**. Park near Wells Fargo Home Mortgage on the NE corner.
Friday, 26th, 7-8:30 am: **Tatum & Deer Valley** (Desert Ridge). Park near Jackson’s Gas Station on the SE corner.
Monday, 29th, 7-8:30am: **Scottsdale & Bell**. Park near Maggiano’s on the SE corner.
---
|
---
|
# PHONE CALLING
---
| **Volunteers are needed to make phone calls from home.**
We’ll give you phone numbers and a script to guide you. Phone numbers will connect you with registered Republican in-person voters. We can also show you how you can hide your phone number to keep it private.
For questions and to sign up, please email Rhonda at Rhonda@KimGeorgeForArizona.com
---
|
---
|
# DOOR KNOCKING
---
| **Volunteers are needed to knock on doors in their neighborhoods. It’s a great way to encourage your neighbors to get out and vote, and to tell them about Kim.**
We can provide a list of addresses of registered Republican in-person voters in your immediate area, so you can tell them why Kim is the candidate they should vote for.
For questions and to sign up, please email Rhonda at Rhonda@KimGeorgeForArizona.com.
---
|
---
|
# ELECTIONEERING AT THE POLLS
---
| **We need Volunteers to stand outside of the polls on election day to hand out palm cards and answer questions about Kim George. You’ll also place a yard sign nearby. You will be given specific guidelines as to what you can and cannot do, and the distance you must keep from the polling place. You may work in pairs.**
We will focus on the following polling places:
* **Cave Creek Town Hall:** 37622 N. Cave Creek Rd., Ste B, Cave Creek, 85331
* **Fountain Hills Community Center:** 13001 N. La Montana Dr., Fountain Hills, 85268

body:
| | | | |
---
| I'm Ken Mitchell, and I'm running to represent Virginia’s 6th Congressional District. I’d like to welcome you to a event on [**Saturday July 20th from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=a95162e39f&e=0fced71d8c) at [Sage Bird Ciderworks](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=27a891fc49&e=0fced71d8c) in Harrisonburg, Virginia.
I’ll be there to answer your questions, chat with folks, and listen to some jazzy live music by [The Queen City Porch Swingers! ](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=7ae5d99c6b&e=0fced71d8c)
---
[RSVP HERE](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=671f55dc81&e=0fced71d8c)
| I understand our community’s needs and am committed to listening to your stories and proposals. Your support is crucial to us reaching every voter possible. It’s not new news that the sixth district is vast and sprawling in many ways - we are home to over **730,000 residents**. It’s also costly to run a campaign against an incumbent that has a [**war chest filled with corrupt money and MAGA loyal lobbyists funds.**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=72608c01c0&e=0fced71d8c)
---
[Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=7aaa0d4568&e=0fced71d8c)
| Please consider donating to our grassroots campaign—[**every contribution helps**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=a0cc92619f&e=0fced71d8c)amplify our voices and drives positive change. We still need to bulk up our staff, increase our field operation, and amplify our message **to every single registered voter in the sixth district.**
---
| [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline and reach more voters?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=6f5dd22c42&e=0fced71d8c)
We should be in this fight together. Not pandering to party loyalists and being bought by large corporations. If we don’t get back to pragmatic problem solving, mutual respect, and putting country before party, our democracy will not survive. We can do better.
Join me in defeating Ben Cline and bringing real representation to the sixth district.
**—Ken Mitchell, Democratic Candidate for Virginia’s 6th Congressional District**

body:
You know Josh Hawley. He’s the guy who went viral last week for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.”
#
Hey Peter,
I’m Lucas Kunce — the 13-year Marine veteran, antitrust advocate, and born-and-raised Missourian running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
You know Josh Hawley. He’s the guy who went viral last week for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.” Or maybe you might recognize him better from his actions on January 6th, 2021...
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=1&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=2&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)**
This email is long. But I wanted to take a moment today to reintroduce myself and tell you more about the historic opportunity we have to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for real Missourians this year. **Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=3&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)
I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=4&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=5&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all.
I want to codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done.
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team.[Please add a donation of any amount right now so we can continue building this movement and finally give power back to everyday, working people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=6&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)**

I’m not just running to make a point — **this is a race we can win.**
**Josh Hawley is vulnerable.** In 2018, he won his seat with only 51% of the vote — and after he exposed himself to be a fraud and a coward on January 6th, he became the least popular Republican Senator up for re-election in 2024.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=14&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)
Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis. And this year, with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban going on the ballot, we expect even more voters to turn out and protect their freedom this November.
So if we’re able to communicate to voters that our campaign is about taking back power for real Missourians, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley.
**But I need you on this team to get it done, Peter.** National insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign have already started attacking me — and over the coming months, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That’s why we need to start preparing right now to fight back and deliver our positive message to voters.
**[Will you chip in anything you can right now so we can keep building this record-breaking grassroots movement and stay prepared for the fight ahead? I don’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big difference to our campaign](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/59342?c0=20240718.wtOJXA&c1=6623.2pefAb&c2=Peter.9FZAnI&c3=Willis.DxIpet&c4=dpwillis67%40gmail.com.6PYeQw&c5=18326.azXo0D&c6=Cresco.ZnkjuH&c7=PA.-gml2d&c8=5%252C20%252C50%252C100%252C250%252C500%252C1000.mKFvx8&t=15&akid=6623%2E614464%2EyTU5IR)**

He’s the guy who went viral last week for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.” Hey Peter, I’m Lucas Kunce — the 13-year Marine veteran, antitrust advocate, and born-and-raised Missourian running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate. You know Josh Hawley. He’s the guy who went viral last week for proudly announcing that he’s “advocating Christian nationalism.” Or maybe you might recognize him better from his actions on January 6th, 2021... This email is long. But I wanted to take a moment today to reintroduce myself and tell you more about the historic opportunity we have to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for real Missourians this year. Please let me explain: I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher. But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. That’s the Missouri I grew up in. Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia. When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. Here’s all that’s left of it: While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people. I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back. So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind. And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all. I want to codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done. Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: I’m not just running to make a point — this is a race we can win. Josh Hawley is vulnerable. Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis. And this year, with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban going on the ballot, we expect even more voters to turn out and protect their freedom this November. So if we’re able to communicate to voters that our campaign is about taking back power for real Missourians, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley. But I need you on this team to get it done, Peter. National insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign have already started attacking me — and over the coming months, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That's how I want to run this race-step by step with generous supporters like you who have funded my campaign.The greatest sign to me that this seat is worth fighting for is your support-when I receive small donations from supporters like you, Fellow American, I'm not only able to fight the Democrat machine, but I'm also personally encouraged to keep fighting. I'm not running in this race so that I can go to brunches with big-name elite politicians. I'm running in this race to turn California around and make it a state you and I can once again be proud of.And to be honest, I'd rather go to brunch with you than Adam Schiff's career politician buddies.Thank you for standing with me.Let's win this together! | | | | go.txting.io/7up80c | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 Click to unsubscribe | |

week before talking about me.

This is the same guy calling for “unity” and toning down the rhetoric.

system over and over again.

due to 'vicious politics'

“It’s a vicious business, politics. I used to think business was worse.
After about two months of dealing with crazy lunatic Adam Schiff and these
people. They’re just liars. They’re horrible liars. We’ve dealt with so
many sick, deranged people that are not stupid people, but they’re
deranged people.”

Donald Trump’s rhetoric is dangerous. I have been sounding that alarm
since his first campaign. And it will only be magnified by the Republican
National Convention and his legions of online MAGA supporters.

He resents truth-tellers. Public servants. And anyone who dares to hold
him to account.

He admires autocrats in other countries and has repeatedly broken the
democratic guardrails we have in place so no president can abuse their
office.

That is why he loathes me — because I investigated him, led his
impeachment trial, and investigated his abuses of power on the January 6
Committee. And no matter how he tries to threaten or intimidate me, I will
never back down.

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Republicans boo’d me at the RNC
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Derek, during my opponent’s speech at the Republican National Convention this week, when he said my name, the crowd actually boo’d me.
Now look, if the GOP wants to yell “boo” at what I’m working for — a strong economy, safe neighborhoods, reproductive freedom for all, and free and fair elections... well, that’s their right.
But in my 30 years of public service in the Commonwealth, I’ve learned that Virginians aren’t name-callers, and we’re not pessimists. We’re optimists. We’re hard workers and problem solvers. We stand up for each other, we don’t tear each other down!
My opponent may not know that yet. (After all, so far he hasn’t been that interested in actually listening to Virginians.)
But come November, I’m willing to bet that he will. Because no matter how much money national Republicans and Trump’s MAGA donors pour into Virginia to flip this seat, we are going to be ready to stand up for what’s right.
To do that, we need to be prepared for an onslaught of attacks, plenty of negative ads, and a whole lot of “boo”s from the GOP — so today, I’m asking you to pitch in a few bucks to my re-election campaign.
With your support, we’re building a massive grassroots outreach campaign that will get our positive message out to voters in every corner of the Commonwealth and boost Democratic turnout in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]

clean_body: [] Derek, during my opponent’s speech at the Republican National Convention this week, when he said my name, the crowd actually boo’d me. Now look, if the GOP wants to yell “boo” at what I’m working for — a strong economy, safe neighborhoods, reproductive freedom for all, and free and fair elections... well, that’s their right. But in my 30 years of public service in the Commonwealth, I’ve learned that Virginians aren’t name-callers, and we’re not pessimists. We’re optimists. We’re hard workers and problem solvers. We stand up for each other, we don’t tear each other down! My opponent may not know that yet. (After all, so far he hasn’t been that interested in actually listening to Virginians.) But come November, I’m willing to bet that he will. Because no matter how much money national Republicans and Trump’s MAGA donors pour into Virginia to flip this seat, we are going to be ready to stand up for what’s right. To do that, we need to be prepared for an onslaught of attacks, plenty of negative ads, and a whole lot of “boo”s from the GOP — so today, I’m asking you to pitch in a few bucks to my re-election campaign. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Committed to a full, equitable storm recovery in Houston / Comprometidos con una recuperación total y equitativa de la tormenta en Houston
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
#NewGridNow:
Fighting for Houstonians still without power and for the local grid we deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Beryl%20flood%20pic.jpg]
Since the start of last week, TOP staff and members from San Antonio and Dallas have been checking up on community members in hard-hit neighborhoods across Houston to share vital resources and assess immediate needs in the aftermath of Hurricane Beryl. Based on our experiences with past flooding and disaster relief, we’re committed to helping connect our Black and Latino communities in Houston with the recovery resources they deserve and working to win a more just disaster recovery system. As of this Tuesday, over a WEEK after the Category 1 hurricane hit, nearly 300,000 Houstonians were STILL without power [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/article/2024/jul/15/texas-heatwave-power-outage] , enduring dangerously hot temperatures. It doesn’t have to be this way!
We need a local power grid that provides affordable and reliable energy to keep the lights on and gets our communities through extreme weather events — no matter our income level, nationality, or ZIP Code.
JOIN TOP and allies on Saturday, July 27, from 12 to 3 p.m. , for a bite to eat at Tomas Bakery & Takeria in Houston, where we'll discuss how we can fight for and win a strong, resilient local grid that will better serve Houston-area residents for years to come.
RSVP HERE to attend the community event. [https://secure.everyaction.com/UJM1mRstBEOBny7yWBhsIw2]
Email Damaris Gonzalez at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] if you or others you know are in need of immediate assistance in the aftermath of Beryl.
Joining San Antonio community members for a forum on health outcomes for people impacted by our legal system
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
BEXAR COUNTY RESIDENTS! TOP's Right2Justice campaign is proud to partner with Fighting Back, Inc. and the University of the Incarnate Word on July 27 from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Barbara Jordan Community Center for a community forum and research study dedicated to assessing the health outcomes of community members impacted by our legal system. DROP BY, if you or someone you know has been directly impacted.
Breakfast and lunch will be provided!
REGISTER to attend and for a chance to win a $25 VISA gift card. [https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=CdMlBrzFIEGYKOo9cHGvGbHC6uKGnr9OkYAzEaKyh-xURFA3N05YQzQ5TFlEMVFEOVFPTFBGSUpCNy4u]
For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
ORGANIZING WIN:
Applauding the work of our partners to advance housing justice nationally
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/CPD%20housing%20justice.jpg]
ORGANIZING MADE THIS HAPPEN: This week, President Biden announced a historic pro-tenant plan to cap rental costs nationwide at 5% for landlords of over 50 units. Read about the win here. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-07-16/biden-calls-for-national-rent-cap-on-large-landlords-to-stem-housing-inflation]
When housing costs continue to soar, hitting tenants of color the hardest, this proposal is a step in the right direction. Now we need Congress to ACT!
This victory from our friends at CPD Action is thanks to tenants organizing and fighting to protect their homes. Let's keep going to build renter power! No matter your age, race, gender, or income, ALL deserve a safe & affordable place to live.
For more information about TOP's housing justice work, contact Sofia Lopez at slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tips: Make sure you, your family, and friends are registered to vote this fall
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Check%20your%20voter%20registration.jpeg]
Don't wait until the last minute — double-check that you're registered to vote NOW to make sure you're good to cast your ballot. Checking your voter registration only takes a few seconds. Visit Vote.org [https://www.vote.org] to double-check your registration. We'll be sending out more helpful voting deadline reminders as we get closer to the fall election, so stay tuned.
Español
#NewGridNow
Luchando por los habitantes de Houston que aún no tienen electricidad y por la red local que merecemos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Beryl%20flood%20pic.jpg]
Desde principios de la semana pasada, el personal y los miembros de TOP de San Antonio y Dallas han estado conectando con los miembros de la comunidad en los vecindarios más afectados de Houston para compartir recursos vitales y evaluar las necesidades inmediatas después del huracán Beryl. Basándonos en nuestras experiencias con inundaciones pasadas y ayuda en casos de desastre, estamos comprometidos a ayudar a conectar a nuestras comunidades Negras y Latinas en Houston con los recursos de recuperación que merecen y a trabajar para lograr un sistema de recuperación de desastres más justo. Hasta el martes, más de una SEMANA después del azote del huracán de categoría 1, casi 300.000 habitantes de Houston TODAVÍA estaban sin electricidad [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/article/2024/jul/15/texas-heatwave-power-outage] y soportando temperaturas peligrosamente altas. Esto no tiene por qué ser así!
Necesitamos una red eléctrica local que proporcione energía asequible y confiable para mantener las luces encendidas y ayudar a nuestras comunidades a superar eventos climáticos extremos, sin importar nuestro nivel de ingresos, nacionalidad o código postal.
ÚNASE a TOP y sus aliados el sábado 27 de julio, de 12 a 3 p.m. , para comer algo en Tomas Bakery & Takeria en Houston, donde discutiremos cómo podemos luchar y ganar una red local fuerte y resiliente que mejorará servir a los residentes del área de Houston en los años venideros.
Confirme su asistencia AQUÍ para asistir al evento comunitario. [https://secure.everyaction.com/UJM1mRstBEOBny7yWBhsIw2]
Envíe un correo electrónico a Damaris González a dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] si usted u otras personas que conoce necesitan asistencia inmediata después de Beryl, o si desea ofrecerse como voluntario para ayudarnos a realizar controles de bienestar.
Unirse a miembros de la comunidad de San Antonio para un foro sobre resultados de salud para las personas afectadas por nuestro sistema legal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Right2Justice.jpg]
¡RESIDENTES DEL CONDADO DE BEXAR! La campaña Right2Justice de TOP se enorgullece de asociarse con Fighting Back, Inc. y la Universidad del Verbo Encarnado el 27 de julio de 10 a.m. a 2 p.m. en el Centro Comunitario Barbara Jordan para un foro comunitario y un estudio de investigación dedicado a evaluar los resultados de salud de los miembros de la comunidad afectados por nuestro sistema legal. Únete a nosotros, si tú o alguien que conoces se ha visto directamente afectado.
¡Se proveerá desayuno y almuerzo!
REGÍSTRESE para asistir y tener la oportunidad de ganar una tarjeta de regalo VISA de $25. [https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=CdMlBrzFIEGYKOo9cHGvGbHC6uKGnr9OkYAzEaKyh-xURFA3N05YQzQ5TFlEMVFEOVFPTFBGSUpCNy4u]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
GANANCIA ORGANIZADORA:
Aplaudiendo el trabajo de nuestros socios para promover la justicia en materia de vivienda a nivel nacional
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/CPD%20housing%20justice.jpg]
LA ORGANIZACIÓN HIZO QUE ESTO SUCEDIERA: Esta semana, el presidente Biden anunció un plan histórico a favor de los inquilinos para limitar los costos de alquiler en todo el país al 5% para los propietarios de más de 50 unidades. Lea sobre la victoria aquí. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-07-16/biden-calls-for-national-rent-cap-on-large-landlords-to-stem-housing-inflation]
Cuando los costos de la vivienda continúan aumentando, afectando más a los inquilinos de color, esta propuesta es un paso en la dirección correcta. ¡Ahora necesitamos que el Congreso ACTÚE!
Esta victoria de nuestros amigos de CPD Action se debe a que los inquilinos se organizaron y lucharon para proteger sus hogares. ¡Sigamos construyendo poder para los inquilinos! No importa su edad, raza, género o ingresos, TODOS merecemos un lugar seguro y asequible para vivir.
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo de justicia de vivienda de TOP, comuníquese con Sofía López en slopez@organizetexas.org [slopez@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Asegúrese de que usted, su familia, y sus amigos estén registrados para votar este otoño
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Check%20your%20voter%20registration.jpeg]
No espere hasta el último minuto: verifique que esté registrado para votar AHORA para asegurarse de que está listo para emitir su voto. Verificar su registro de votante solo le llevará unos segundos. Visite Vote.org [https://www.Vote.org] para verificar su registro. Enviaremos más recordatorios útiles sobre la fecha límite de votación a medida que nos acerquemos a las elecciones de otoño, así que estad atentos.

body:
Seriously, it's time for us to stop treating politics like entertainment and reality TV. | | |
---
Folks, Donald Trump just wrapped up another speech, this time from the Republican convention. **It was the same Trump that we know, just on a different night.** He said that he would bring unity. Meanwhile, he stoked the flames of hatred and division. He said he would bring safety. But he also praised Hannibal Lecter and said he would “round up millions” of people into mass detention camps. (I’m not kidding.) He said that he would fix things. Do you remember his administration? He only created more mess for the rest of us to clean up. **I don't mean to be facetious, but bringing people together and getting things done just isn't in Trump's DNA.****_And we can’t afford four more years of it_.** [**Now, I've got a whole lot more to say, but first, will you join the millions of Americans who've already pitched in to defeat Donald Trump and J.D. Vance? Trump laid out his plans in full form. He wants to ban abortion nationwide, cut Social Security, rip away health care protections, and --_this is the God's honest truth_ \-- jack up taxes on working families by an average of $2,500 a year by placing a 10 percent tariff on _everything_ we import, from coffee beans to cars.
**Folks, Americans want a president, not a dictator; to keep their freedoms, not give them up.**
That's why, when I'm reelected, I'm going to restore _Roe v. Wade_ as the law of the land. I'll defend the right to vote, make sure billionaires pay their fair share in taxes, lower the cost of housing, and get weapons of war off our streets.
**But most importantly of all, and I give you my word as a Biden: I will**** _always_****uphold our Constitution and defend our democracy.**

subject: Is Capitalism More Humane Than Socialism? Get the Free eBook
body:
This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp97gose43874ctjn797sftv6o641hfn2a258958_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge8ob4cjh2bs)

| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl8uksv54kiqjhbkjrd3phj4gdmgf77n5fbav1o8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge8ob4cjh2bs)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

[Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhnaet0dpk7qgjcj0oo6gokau7rtlqo3rmpm6d68_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge8ob4cjh2bs)

Greg Stamps

subject: The Patriotic Roadmap I Wrote for You
body:
We’re in a moment of national reflection.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjguj2a9ik36auesfielm7gjd9aghm8ogmu42evg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecoj1clh2bs)
---
Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvlbgepgtpfbn6fs0a5athcgp31oolibqdc251j8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecoj1clh2bs)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zij790lqhgl6cgihel1l3tnh8ojrclts6j2184v8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecoj1clh2bs)
---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:

subject: They want you to forget this
body:
You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era.

| |

| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbbpej29vbhemiqiaqa5stgtcblqcu1ojjkgcj60_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecpj2chh2bs)
---
Fellow American, You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era. **Thou****sands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. It’s the natural tendency of the authoritarian left to punish people for refusing to go along with its schemes. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to initiate legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ **[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7edeqdf202v73inlsubqr1jjkmn90iaigrisoo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecpj2chh2bs)** When the Symphony introduced their vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs, filed for exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish. **To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them. They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist.The good news is that while cultural Marxism is popular on college campuses, legacy media press rooms, the boardrooms of woke companies and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. **[**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvtr31ug3sr9lefqt0353qkf2u1fun0snqkan3t8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpgecpj2chh2bs)** Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: you’ve got mail! 📢
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

For preborn children, elections have _life or death_ consequences.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gjiiuik-duchtdja-y/) And the stakes are higher in 2024 than ever.

**This November, states across the country are facing extreme pro-abortion ballot measures that, if passed, could legalize abortion-on-demand up until birth.**

Unfortunately, there are pro-life voters in these states who may sit out this election cycle . . . _unless we inspire them to turn out!_

Which is why _Students for Life Action_ has ramped up all our critical Election Year plans into high gear!

This includes our brand-new **_Get Out the Pro-Life Vote Postcard Campaign!_**

This campaign is designed to get voters to hear from you and our pro-life student leaders that preborn children are crying out for them this election.

You see, if you **donate just $1.01** to our _Get Out the Pro-Life Vote Postcard Campaign,_ our student leaders will hand-write and send ONE mind-changing postcard to a potential voter, _who we think is pro-life but unlikely to vote,_ in a Battleground State where we’re fighting radical abortion referendums – _such as Arizona, Florida, Missouri, Nebraska, and South Dakota._

**[So, will you make your most generous contribution of $75.75, $50.50, or $25.25 right away to help _Students for Life Action_ volunteers mail out as many postcards as possible in these critical ballot referendum states](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gjiiuik-duchtdja-j/)?**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gjiiuik-duchtdja-t/) The postcard is meant to educate a pro-lifer who may need extra encouragement to **_VOTE NO_** on their state’s pro-abortion ballot referendum.

Here’s how it works . . .

1. Your donation covers the cost of the number of voters you want to reach with these hand-written cards.

2. Our pro-life student leaders will personally sign the postcards and mail them. _Studies show that personalized notes make voters pay more attention to the piece of mail!_

3\. We will mail postcards to low-propensity, pro-life voters in key Battleground and ballot referendum states on your behalf!
That's it! Your action today will be key in turning out more voters to defend preborn children this November.

**[Mail a _Get Out the Pro-Life Vote_ Postcard on my behalf >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gjiiuik-duchtdja-i/)**

The time to fight is now, Pro-Life Friend.

Every small effort you make creates an impact far bigger than you can imagine.

Thank you for everything you continue to do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

**P.S. –** **[Please consider chipping in an extra $10 or $25 to help us cover the cost of buying pizzas for our student leaders who are volunteering their time to handwrite hundreds of postcards with heartfelt pro-life messages encouraging voters to get out and vote Pro-Life](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gjiiuik-duchtdja-d/)!**

subject: Is Capitalism More Humane Than Socialism? Get the Free eBook
body:
This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2znj3dchh1pass5f21ir6pa9uue7nr1rd13hjjevo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge1or6c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zd5t0fo255hndcn2a5tnjpegihnmkruiimhavit8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge1or6c1h2bs)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

[Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zpjhbrjfncuotu5t8r7bg6qabip7ahvnshe1r288_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cpge1or6c1h2bs)

Best regards,
Greg Stamps

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: Can I send you my new book?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW1O1AuWGN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW1O1AuWGN

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

Support
Turning Point USA

Beverly Road
Phoenix,
Arizona 85044

Request for Volunteers
| | | |
---
VOLUNTEER NEWSLETTER
Dear Peter:
Beth Weddle, Campaign Manager, for Mark Robertson, reaching out once again to those of you who helped on the 2022 campaign and on Mark's campaign leading up to the primary. As most of you know by now, Mark won the Republican primary in Nevada's First Congressional District and now is facing off for the second time against Dina Titus in the General Election on November 5, 2024.
There are only 93 days until the General Election, and we need your HELP!
Here is what we need:
* Volunteer Coordinator: This is an important job that requires a few hours of your time each week. This volunteer would maintain our volunteer database and provide reports and lists to campaign staff members for various campaign activities (marketing, fundraising, GOTV, texting, door knocking, telephoning, texting, etc.) * Social Media Guru: This volunteer will help Mark get seen on social media sites. Possibly teach volunteers how to spread the word on Facebook, Instagram, etc. * Sign Volunteers: We need people in various parts of CD1 to store a few signs at their home and deliver them to homes as needed. * Walkers to distribute campaign literature in your neighborhood (or other neighborhoods as needed, if you are able). We will provide you the materials and a list of homes. We may also have some "group" walks where we meet in a specific location and walk together. * Phone callers to make calls to voters. You will be provided a script. We plan to use a phone-calling app, and nine times out of ten, you will push a button and leave a voicemail.
In order for Mark to beat Dina Titus and get elected to Congress in the fall, we need a large group of volunteers. If you are willing to help Mark get elected, please just reply to this email or phone me, Beth Weddle, 702-526-5934, [Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com](mailto:Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com). I would love to speak with you and discuss how you might be able to help!
Sincerely,
Beth Weddle Campaign Manager Robertson For Congress 702-526-5934 [Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com](mailto:Beth@RobertsonForCongress.com)

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

**Good Morning**! On this day in 64, [the great fire of Rome](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFvhCAUwPFPgxsGngjHwNDF7bp2NCiP8zUoF6Bn_PZNm46df8M__4_7fPeU6Hi8-x1di3n2a6MXzoZLy0HNqgsuIgIOHTppQA5WazN0mxuNEX4VK3pjrb6N0YZog9AwjmpZjO7IgQAljLRSCKlu_bJaCzHc5KDQjkEyJTBQy6X_zHS0DWO68gtLv-a9S25r7VnZ8MZgYjCd59lvVFsu148zmNpGlQd_cTr4nzCYDiy58pJ35MtXOWpXXHielBJVbZgSj91T-i20_39fDr4DAAD__-UGWLs) broke out and destroyed much of the city. Despite the well-known stories, there is no evidence that the Roman emperor Nero either started the fire or played the fiddle while it burned. ## Trump Speech Details Shooting
Donald Trump accepted the Republican nomination for president for the third time Thursday night in a rally-style speech that [called for unity across America](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFy4yAUheGnQR0auLBGFBTbqPO2W2oQXNk3g0ABZE3ePuPUac9pvvn_35e7p0T58c_v6PpWFh86vXAxXFoOetFDdBsioBrQSQNS2dvNqOHpVqMFWrFN0Yuwgg8GpNZBKA9RKSEHciBACyOtFELqaVyDtbDFSSqN9k-UTAuM1EsdPwrl_sQtfZUX1jGUfUju2fvRmPrLYGYwX9c1Vjw71vb-30upKTKYz8ZgXili5psP2HilRvnBj4qtnRX550md93ruB_ch4NF5Ljtl36lk_jZyYbicGMxDdfG4KCVqN8O0eOye0g-n_x7n5eA7AAD__81kZzk) and confidently predicted victory in the fall. In Trump's first speaking appearance since he was shot last weekend, [he recounted nearly being killed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhSAUgOGnwQ3jOXBFBoYubrdrR4NyvJ4GwQjV9O2bdu78L3--j-f09Bw5vd79Tq6uefJL5YsmI8FK1JNugluJkFRDDgyCsn1vVLM5guExKDtDPxilZtCWZjBBa1qHGWbdsMMOdWfAQteBHtp5sRbXMIDSZB8BhO4ocM1n-5k51Y3W-J0vOtsl7010W61HEepN4ChwvO-7TfOS6C6_XeCY8i1wvDhQFjjW82s_ZKDqORbpS_GlcPKVc5K-VtqPKjnJMy2yHETLJhEeCKpXZjDQnC4cN8fIpTdCd6_dc_z7qP-rXA5_AgAA__-uXWR4) in compelling detail to a hushed crowd. On stage with him was the volunteer fire uniform and helmet of Corey Comperatore, who died shielding his family from the shooter. The 90-minute speech pivoted halfway through to include a recitation of issues where the current "incompetent" administration had failed, and how Trump planned to address those, including strictly tightening the border, ending the federal push for electric cars, and immediately drilling for oil and gas. Trump's speech was the main event of a star-studded evening. [Wrestler Hulk Hogan spoke,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngc0R90KCGRi6eEvXjhaBi6Hlx3JIor591c6dj3Sk7-O6Xl0uuW3vrpIdsa_Oj_ykVU9gJlSr4sFGIiTJyYJGkOZy0ZIna0D4-RYx4mzM-QwhaG-kDE7SrBElzxYFKqHBgBCg5tPNG4MxzCAVmXMApgSFPPpx-uy5jUSxfPcnHSffKy82jbHfmXxjuDBcRqKUS_ltDJfUKzV63Rku3tXd5a0xXJSeQUiY0qN8Talvrk3jeNR9OppnuPDDhv2VS8n3i2ZKbNXlvyEf_9OfFn8CAAD___21Wjs) rocker Kid Rock performed, and country singer Lee Greenwood led up to Trump's introduction with his hit, "God Bless the USA."
## Biden Considers Ending Campaign
After weeks of resisting calls from congressional Democrats to step down, President Biden now seems open to the idea of [ending his re-election bid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOszAQBOCnMd1GeE0AFy7-xl3-9kpkzJrsydgWOER5-xNXX72rTzPz9ZgejiOn9b_byNSQJ-crnzQNIDVgN3XNYgIRkmrIyAGl0n0_qOZp3HjXblZzH8j3Y69Q3rUfZVADBaXc0rDBFrt2kFq2rezG2-y1xrCMUnWk74sUXUsL17zfvjOn-qQQP_mk_ebz1kTzrLUcQv0TaAXa9Cn5qNdJoL1ggbYdBFo5CrSvAxK9D4F25oUSpPyGmTitsJOnclUCN-dXhZKPg2eOXD-QA6x8Xl-vApcJOwFF8pVzAu-24nhNlww7lbxXgbbZzVLeHCMf_SC6dt0cx9_E9e_9ToM_AQAA__8la3L1), according to a senior Democratic adviser. Biden's apparent change of heart coincides with reports that former Speaker Nancy Pelosi spoke directly to the President and told him [he couldn't win](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGy2yAQheGnQd16YIUFFBRp1N20KTVIrMwmGDQCW5O3zzj1bc9pvvl_fS1fgTOXx8_wJN_3uoSt85sWA8oB6kUP0e9ESONAXhlUo5smMw7JG0lWakQrp9UGp53V6328W5IrWrWbgT1K1NIop6RU2t7WzTnco1WjJnePSmhJkXs9b78rl55oz3_rm87bVp9D9qn3o4nxh8BZ4Hxd1-2kV6ezff7PUs8cBc6vJnA-KNfGsFLiEqFtifcdtpAzrBypQOt0QGgcCWKlVjr0xOUPJIItFLi4wJW4E6T6agQfOUgDygqch9PH4-KcuU1GaPl4Bs7_kf37ZG-P_wIAAP__SC9t2w) the election. Other prominent Democrats, including Representatives Adam Schiff and Hakeem Jeffries, as well as Senator Chuck Schumer, [have expressed concerns](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd1gwEBMKite4y2u3tAwMyawIWIBi5e9X2Xrre6VzdL5u222nTOX-f3-iG6luexj0ws1waTnoTU_RJURANaGTBqSyy2LU9HDeK2O1Td7YC4gYhTJJetSY9FWmKCdyIEALI60UQurr7IO1kOJVKo32EiXTAiON2ubvSmU8MOV3fWGbQ31O2T3GODpT_xisDNbzPOfiQ8Gzf3YG61EzDQqdwfoBccwYBtXCYPUUsfCzthy5b3vAzo_aO3nKNN78aNg_j8H7wKPzFsouF9BWT83F46ScqS-GaXF_7pR_fcbfdV4OfgIAAP__irFosA) about Biden's position on the ticket. Recent polls indicate that the President's candidacy could jeopardize the party's control of Congress. Further complicating Biden's position are [leaked chats](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL8Gd0RwISYUFK-hy2u3tAj32maXgBVIIv_9yrvtlqORjmbOx3W6hpRTWf6HO7k-1ynEnl40GS4tBz3pAd1MBKQGctKAVHYcjRpWJ6XCESOdaZZW3xCkMjEqq_U4Asw4JAcCtDDSSiGkvpxu0VqY8SKVJntGybQgTL0-Tp81lb7SnPf6oscp1vuQ3dr71pj6x8Az8GXfautHxcAfYAZeGAZeXhj4Z-OF3o2BxxI5UqYldGr8903eOaYWn62lsvBbQiq8ddq2I2J9F54KzxS-CHlcQz84w8Ph9k45pzYapsVyDyn_LOt_e3o5-A4AAP__gwZqfQ) from DNC delegates worried that a second Biden term is an impossible sell to voters.
## Comedy Legend Bob Newhart Dies
Legendary [deadpan comedian and television star](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAUAH8NbI7g8cLHwNAlW7p2tPh4xFTERDay1X9fpXPH0w2n-7rP91BbXR-f4Ul-lD6HNOpBs5mkmwBn5NkXIiDFyUsDUjmtjeKLt1YK0KpcFWjCZAXFAjqTUUYDRc2rBwEojHRSCIn2EpNzULKVCslds2QoKNfRt8t3r-tYqLSfftB2Sf3Jm1_GeO1MfTC4MbiF10rn_lZv2EZNjRjcYo_TSucStjFlCnkyzqEW0UBUCQ2ZEAoSRUBdhIg28c3n11lbq7s2DMXjGWr7K47__w8PvwEAAP__cSRaug) Bob Newhart died on Thursday. subject: Act now to crack down on dirty LNG exports
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
We must do everything we can to stop this
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2703927/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

The Biden-Harris administration didn't just pause approvals on exports of harmful liquid "natural" gas—their Department of Energy (DOE) opened a review on the economic and environmental studies that help determine if LNG export terminals are in the "public interest." (_Spoiler: They are not._)

This was huge. And even though a Trump-appointed judge recently halted the LNG pause, DOE still has the authority to update its "public interest" analysis.

**Just one problem: Oil-drenched Republicans in Congress won't stop trying to use other bills to sneak in amendments that would take this authority away from DOE.** In fact, they're trying to do it again this week.

We've already sent **9,428** messages to members of Congress urging them to support the LNG pause and do everything they can to hasten a just transition to a clean energy future. That's incredible!

Yet it's crucial that our lawmakers keep hearing from as many constituents as possible right now so they know we want them to stop LNG from poisoning our health and future—[**and we need your voice.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2703928/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[SEND A MESSAGE NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2703929/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| We know that LNG export terminals are a massive threat to public health because they release dangerous pollutants into surrounding communities, particularly Black, Brown, and low-income ones where these facilities are often sited. Communities on the Gulf Coast shouldn't have to deal with symptoms like headaches, dizziness, and respiratory irritation—not to mention other severe health issues like cancer or heart disease—which is why **Congress should do everything in its power to drop this dangerous amendment.**

[**I hope you'll take a minute to send a message to your representatives in Congress before it's too late.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2703930/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
| Thanks for all you do, |
---
| | |
---
### Mattea Mrkusic

subject: eggs & stiff joints
body:
Brace yourself...

Hi friend,

Brace yourself... because you may end up throwing out a lot of the food in your fridge after you finish reading today's email.

You see, Maryland physician Dr. Brian Paris says many so-called "health foods" are actually the cause of sore, stiff joints that make you feel miserable.

_"If you 're in constant, chronic, excruciating agony and don't feel well, it has to do with what you're eating... and just as important... what you're not eating but should eat," _says Dr. Paris.

Dr. Paris found certain foods marketed as being healthy...

...actually contain a toxic nutrient your immune system sees as the enemy.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e78eb1e04a2b49c796d4179081a42837&_e=e2Cs-yhoL7RbC0VhwtphtzSWsM4qs7MjNCAkfaxlsar82FSeFVgYmj2DRtyODCJeZUdY9Y5zErVKRchZ9J--aSXUVS_hYrQdzT5dReWrzEWYaoB8liy2ENoJ0fa_yovoFByAqPagjQkkxTCqrvmcSb2VsMObonhztIP9PJZQ9BU3R6KSIgL3CXLLPQrgt5o8LNjT5kteywR4Dt3SorYzDIT59IzKnP574vncBRqkYN6klLJVpoLCdP-wcft9gvAkhOYjOwuoDpfHMZtqNMOYfJlJS-4ajYXZ-8MR6sqHuQL6pBUnRg9g68t3GtlTS1ae)

So, every time you take a bite of one of these foods... your immune system unleashes its "army" to attack this nutrient.

And since this nutrient enters your bloodstream once it's digested... your immune system starts attacking even healthy tissue and organs... **_causing burning in your joints and muscles_**.

Dr. Paris explains, _"Most of my patients assume their joint issues are a normal part of the aging process. They have no idea eating the wrong foods can cause joint problems."_

The good news is... this problem is EASY to fix.

_"You don't have to completely change your diet. Just eliminating_[** __these 5 foods from your diet__**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e78eb1e04a2b49c796d4179081a42837&_e=e2Cs-yhoL7RbC0VhwtphtzSWsM4qs7MjNCAkfaxlsar82FSeFVgYmj2DRtyODCJeZUdY9Y5zErVKRchZ9J--aSXUVS_hYrQdzT5dReWrzEWYaoB8liy2ENoJ0fa_yovoFByAqPagjQkkxTCqrvmcSb2VsMObonhztIP9PJZQ9BUHXbVIS_J2PbWJUwHcnmVKPqxxrS8rgvpM6plMXYEt0cEQcBwVPILoH4OdIb4NR4U18XV80_Rs5w-fzIPtK2Z-YZebtASBgLB2GNpmcIaWrZpPMsYotHbSD-CknMJIo9xseh8z2Y7Aw_ILJms-LGOs) _\- including a certain kind of vegetable - will do wonders to your life,"_ he says.

In his entire 20-year career as a doctor, Dr. Paris has found eliminating these 5 foods to be the most powerful drug-free defense against joint problems.

So far, he's helped thousands of people at his private clinic... including some very famous celebrities and NFL athletes.

Now, he's put his list of [**_the 5 worst foods_**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e78eb1e04a2b49c796d4179081a42837&_e=e2Cs-yhoL7RbC0VhwtphtzSWsM4qs7MjNCAkfaxlsar82FSeFVgYmj2DRtyODCJeZUdY9Y5zErVKRchZ9J--aSXUVS_hYrQdzT5dReWrzEWYaoB8liy2ENoJ0fa_yovoFByAqPagjQkkxTCqrvmcSb2VsMObonhztIP9PJZQ9BWbY_AwnKUPNIml80BsJ6IWWwXx_X5gyDVRqjPIDIcv_zkPl15J6kRWi956SHlEj-zhFTblWL_qyh9BqCZzcWGuLB236xGs55JSsg39iS54Ko-rjJkZBa4rIziv_8G48ijusSzsAWIIMPktesZqGsP7) (and every other trick he's learned in 20 years) into a free video available to the public..

So far, hundreds of thousands of Americans are feeling much better after following the advice in this video... which is probably why it's going viral on Facebook.

# [The Nixon administration tried to deport John Lennon.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| Y ou don’t have to imagine Richard Nixon trying to deport John Lennon, because it actually happened, in 1972. The 37th President of the United States was no fan of the former Beatle, whose ballad “Give Peace a Chance” became a rallying cry among anti-Vietnam War activists who believed the best way to end the conflict was to make Nixon a one-term commander in chief. This was highly irksome during Nixon’s 1972 reelection campaign, and the famously vindictive leader responded by sending the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS) after Lennon, under the pretense that he had been allowed into America improperly since he’d been charged with a marijuana-related misdemeanor in England in 1968.
---
Their [efforts were unsuccessful](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), in part because Lennon had a little help from his friends. Artists such as Bob Dylan, Joan Baez, Leonard Bernstein, Joyce Carol Oates, and John Updike wrote letters on behalf of Lennon and his wife Yoko Ono. The administration kept pushing for deportation despite the “let them stay in the USA” campaign, and even after Nixon won reelection in a landslide. A year after Nixon resigned in disgrace, a three-judge panel ruled in the musician’s favor, [writing in its ruling](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that “Lennon’s four-year battle to remain in our country is testimony to his faith in this American dream.”

## John Lennon hated his singing voice.
Despite being one of the most influential and beloved musicians in history, John Lennon hated the sound of his own voice. In addition to [telling](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) biographer Ray Coleman, “I can’t say I ever liked hearing myself,” Lennon requested that Beatles producer George Martin “do something” to his voice to make it sound different, even going so far as to ask him, “Can’t you smother it with tomato ketchup or something?” [According to Martin](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvalw&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), Lennon “had an inborn dislike of his own voice which I could never understand, as it was one of the best voices I’ve heard.” Millions upon millions of fans agree.

The 37th President of the United States was no fan of the former Beatle, whose ballad “Give Peace a Chance” became a rallying cry among anti-Vietnam War activists who believed the best way to end the conflict was to make Nixon a one-term commander in chief. This was highly irksome during Nixon’s 1972 reelection campaign, and the famously vindictive leader responded by sending the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS) after Lennon, under the pretense that he had been allowed into America improperly since he’d been charged with a marijuana-related misdemeanor in England in 1968. Their , in part because Lennon had a little help from his friends. Artists such as Bob Dylan, Joan Baez, Leonard Bernstein, Joyce Carol Oates, and John Updike wrote letters on behalf of Lennon and his wife Yoko Ono. The administration kept pushing for deportation despite the “let them stay in the USA” campaign, and even after Nixon won reelection in a landslide. A year after Nixon resigned in disgrace, a three-judge panel ruled in the musician’s favor, that “Lennon’s four-year battle to remain in our country is testimony to his faith in this American dream.” | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Rank of “Imagine” on Rolling Stone’s 2004 list of the “500 Greatest Songs of All Time” 3 | | Nixon’s approval rating at the end of his presidency 24% | Nixon’s approval rating at the end of his presidency 24% | | Lennon’s place on BBC’s 2002 list of the “100 Greatest Britons” 8 | | Electoral votes won by Nixon in the 1972 presidential election 520 | Electoral votes won by Nixon in the 1972 presidential election 520 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- John Lennon hated his singing voice. Despite being one of the most influential and beloved musicians in history, John Lennon hated the sound of his own voice. In addition to biographer Ray Coleman, “I can’t say I ever liked hearing myself,” Lennon requested that Beatles producer George Martin “do something” to his voice to make it sound different, even going so far as to ask him, “Can’t you smother it with tomato ketchup or something?” , Lennon “had an inborn dislike of his own voice which I could never understand, as it was one of the best voices I’ve heard.” Millions upon millions of fans agree. clean_body: I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before | | | Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--for the better. Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,Right Wing Revolution,as a guide for a return to an America where ... We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Friend, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. JULY 19, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Dahlstrom is Getting Her Message in Front of Alaskans Across the State

ANCHORAGE, AK - Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, the Republican House
candidate endorsed by President Trump, had an eventful week getting her
message out in front of Alaskans across the state.

In the wake of the assassination attempt on President Trump, Lt.
Governor Dahlstrom hit the ground running
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70335&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63133> to show Alaskans that Republicans are
unified.

On Monday, Lt. Governor Dahlstrom took part in the Bear Paw Parade
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70335&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63134> and attended the Fairbanks Golden Days
Chamber Luncheon
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70335&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63135> , where she met with Alaskans looking for
economic relief from the Biden-Harris-Peltola agenda.

Alaska's top-raising Republican House candidate also celebrated
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70335&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63136> her friend Governor Mike Dunleavy
pledging all of Alaska's delegates behind President Trump and she
joined Duane Bannock for Sound Off in Kenai, Alaska for an interview on
Thursday.

"Alaskans know what's at stake in this election and they know they need
a leader who will make time to speak to them and put our state above
all else," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said in a statement. "I was
proud to share President Trump's message throughout Alaska this week as
he accepted our party's nomination in Milwaukee. It's an honor to have
his endorsement and I will work with President Trump, Vice President
Vance, and Alaska's United States Senators to Make America and Alaska
Great Again!"

subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/19/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone!
What a wonderful experience we had at this year's Republican National Convention! Each day was filled with powerful speeches that truly resonated with all of us. From the moving words of Gold Star families to the insightful perspectives shared by Elon Musk and Tucker Carlson, each moment was a testament to the strength and unity of our party. Melania Trump graced the stage with elegance and wisdom, reminding us of the values we hold dear. And then, there was the man, the myth, the legend—President Donald J. Trump, whose presence underscored the vibrancy and the enduring spirit of our great party. It's clear that after this convention, the Republican Party is more united than ever. We are bonded by a common goal to save America for each and every person. Together, we stand ready to face the future, invigorated by the unity and commitment demonstrated at the convention.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, July 19, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl, from the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Hancey: An open letter to Ms. Reed, asking for your resignation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE,](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) COMMENTARY
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I respectfully ask for your immediate resignation!_
_You have had the privilege of being a leader to your community on at least two different occasions: 1. As a teacher and survivor of the shooting at Columbine High School and 2. As a currently elected non-partisan official on the Jefferson County School Board._
_I can relate._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**MANDY CONNELL ON THE STREET AT THE RNC**
**[07-18-24 FULL SHOW - The Generational Torch Was Passed Last Night](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) []()** [THE MANDY CONNELL PODCAST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**RNC COVERAGE**
**[Saying their names: Families of U.S. troops killed in Kabul airport bombing criticize Biden, praise Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AIR FORCE TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gold Star families spoke at the Republican National Convention, criticizing President Biden for his handling of the Afghanistan withdrawal and not recognizing their fallen relatives.

* The emotional presentation highlighted the contrast between Trump’s engagement with military families and Biden’s actions during the withdrawal.

* The segment underscored bipartisan criticism of the withdrawal process, initiated under Trump but executed under Biden without a clear plan, leading to tragic results.

|
---
**[Who do they, as border residents, trust to protect them from drug cartels? Donald Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jim and Sue Chilton, Arizona ranch owners, described increased danger and illegal activity on their property since President Biden took office, at the Republican National Convention.
* They attributed safer conditions during Trump's presidency to his border policies and advocated for his re-election to complete the border wall and enhance security.
* David Lara, from a border town, also criticized the Biden administration’s border policies, emphasizing the need for Trump's leadership to curb illegal immigration and improve safety.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**STATE AND LOCAL**
**[Federal judge rules, ‘sideshows’ aside, no Colorado voter intimidation by ‘election integrity’ organizer](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A federal judge dismissed a case accusing an "election integrity" group of intimidating Colorado voters, citing a lack of evidence that their door-to-door canvassing was illegal.
* The groups involved alleged the U.S. Election Integrity Plan's canvassing spread fear among voters, referencing their contentious materials and statements by members suggesting harsh penalties for those found guilty of election fraud.
* The judge criticized the plaintiffs for insufficient evidence and changing their legal strategy mid-trial, emphasizing that no actual voter intimidation was proven

_**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**[Paralyzed mountain lion found in Colorado is first case of “staggering disease” in North America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A mountain lion in Douglas County, Colorado, showing paralysis symptoms was euthanized and found to be the first North American case of "staggering disease" caused by the rustrela virus.
* The virus, previously known in European cats, affects muscles and the nervous system, prompting research into its presence in North American wildlife.
* Colorado State University urges increased screening for the virus in mammals and further study of potential reservoir hosts in the region.

|

Trump announced U.S. Sen. J.D. Vance, R-Ohio, would be his vice-presidential running mate on the Republican Party’s presidential ticket, it concluded months of speculation._

The recent assassination attempt on President Donald Trump’s life is a stark example of this._

Each day was filled with powerful speeches that truly resonated with all of us. The segment underscored bipartisan criticism of the withdrawal process, initiated under Trump but executed under Biden without a clear plan, leading to tragic results. | []() Jim and Sue Chilton, Arizona ranch owners, described increased danger and illegal activity on their property since President Biden took office, at the Republican National Convention. They attributed safer conditions during Trump's presidency to his border policies and advocated for his re-election to complete the border wall and enhance security. Derek,
With the Republican National Convention going on this week in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, I thought now would be a good time to check in on the former RNC finance chair and current Postmaster General, Louis DeJoy.
A federal judge ruled that DeJoy's changes to the U.S. Postal Service before the 2020 election harmed mail delivery and impeded voting by mail at the height of the pandemic. **Now this Trump appointee is poised to be running the mail during the upcoming presidential election._Again_.**
**[If you’re ready to join me in calling on President Biden to submit his nominees for the USPS Board of Governors to the Senate for confirmation so we can replace DeJoy, then add your name to my petition today. DeJoy’s stunning controversies and conflicts of interest make him unfit to lead the Postal Service.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240719-dejoy-petition.xKL-ai&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240719_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=7097%2E5257348%2EzndcfZ)**

---
Before accepting Trump’s nomination, DeJoy spent years raising and contributing millions to Republican candidates as the RNC finance chair.
He has been the subject of an FBI investigation into an alleged straw donor scheme for Republican candidates, where he would award bonuses as kickbacks for political donations.
**Democrats even had to step in and stop him from purchasing 90% gasoline-powered vehicles instead of moving to a green fleet.**
I mean, _come on_.
DeJoy is poised to run the Postal Service during another presidential election, where the guy who gave him the job and then incited a violent insurrection when he lost is threatening to deny the results if he loses.
**[President Biden needs to move with haste to submit his nominees for the two USPS Board of Governors vacancies to the Senate so they can replace DeJoy. He is unfit to serve as Postmaster General, plain and simple.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240719-dejoy-petition.xKL-ai&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240719_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=7097%2E5257348%2EzndcfZ)**
[STOP DEJOY](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240719-dejoy-petition.xKL-ai&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240719_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=7097%2E5257348%2EzndcfZ)
---
I know this isn’t the typical message you are hearing during the RNC this week, but it’s important that we not lose sight of the critical role of vote-by-mail, and the need to take action. We cannot risk another election with DeJoy at the helm.
Thanks,
Adam
