The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue! —Tim
Hello, this is Missy Cotter Smasal.
I’m the Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in Virginia’s 2nd District, and I’m committed to being a strong voice for the issues that motivate Virginians – like supporting veterans and military families, building up our economy, and preserving our fundamental rights and democracy.
I’m proud to have the endorsement of Senator Tim Kaine, and I hope I can count on your support today, too. Will you split a donation between Senator Kaine’s re-election campaign and my campaign for Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-missy]
I’m a Navy veteran, former small business owner, and mom of two great kids. I know what it means to stand up for our values – and what it takes to make our communities safer and stronger, to revitalize the local economy, and to protect and restore Virginia’s coastline.
Reproductive rights and access are at the forefront of this campaign! Women have an innate right to control their own bodies, and you shouldn’t lose that right because of where you live, who controls your national or state legislature, or where your military orders station you and your family.
Coastal Virginia has a vibrant and diverse community of veteran and military families like my own, and I’m committed to ensuring that veterans and military families receive the benefits they’ve earned, and that we keep our promises to those who have served our nation.
The MAGA extremists who are increasingly rising to power in Congress don’t represent my family, my values, or the people in my community. That’s why I’m running – to stand up for our values and be a steadfast champion for the people of Coastal Virginia.
This November, we have a chance to win back Virginia’s 2nd District, but I’m going to need your help to do it. Will you help to power my campaign by splitting a donation between Tim Kaine and me today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-missy]
Thank you for your support and let’s win together!
Sincerely,
Missy

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:

subject: Good, bad, and ugly
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
It’s James Carville. Read this right now.

In today's financial landscape, many investors are feeling disillusioned and disappointed with traditional investment options. The once-trusted pillars of real estate, stocks, and bonds have left many Americans feeling unsecured, unprotected, and lacking confidence in their financial strategy. [**Why the sudden loss of trust?** ](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvhvu&__onlt=h) Last year witnessed the dramatic failures of three of the largest financial institutions in American history. This year, Republic First Bank also collapsed. On May 29th, 2024, The FDIC report highlighted **Half-A-Trillion** in paper losses, with the number of problem banks increasing from 52 to 63 in just one quarter. This marks the ninth consecutive quarter of substantial unrealized losses, a troubling trend that seems to be unstoppable. While traditional investments often come with promises of high returns and stability, the reality is that the financial world is like a stormy sea, and traditional investments often fall short. Inflation and interest rates remain high, prices fluctuate, stocks soar and crash, and bonds offer minimal returns. American investors need assets that can weather these storms and protect their wealth. This is where gold shines. **[So, Why Gold? While traditional investments fluctuate based on market sentiment, gold and silver often move inversely, making them valuable tools for balancing risks in a portfolio. So why is gold purposely overlooked? **Financial advisors often overlook gold due to conflicts of interest, prioritizing assets that generate ongoing fees or commissions. Physical gold, however, doesn’t fit this bill.** Once you own gold, there are no recurring fees or commissions for advisors to gain from, making it less appealing from their perspective. But as an investor focused on long-term stability and diversification, gold should not be overlooked. Consider the last global financial crisis: while many assets took a nosedive, gold prices soared. **[Those with gold in their portfolio had a safety net,](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvhvu&__onlt=h)** which makes it a buffer against total loss. Your interest in gold and silver may not be apparent yet, but these metals offer peace of mind, security, stability, potential growth, and diversification. Traits you can't afford to overlook. It is simple to realize the power of gold and silver if you wish to. They are the missing pieces in your financial puzzle. **[Download your FREE comprehensive educational E-Book: "The Power of Gold” and educate yourself about how it could transform your financial strategy.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvhvu&__onlt=h)** [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgvhvu&__onlt=h)

The younger generation faces the harsh reality of unaffordable housing, grappling with the challenge of securing stable homes of their own.
As housing prices soar, many young people find themselves priced out of the market, unable to afford decent living situations. This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can [get your free copy at this link.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/w2y7gADaowFGBAGX7oVG1g~~/AARclAA~/RgRofQbmP0TEaHR0cHM6Ly9yZXNvdXJjZXMuaG9vdmVyLm9yZy9wZXJzb25hbC1mcmVlZG9tLWFuZC10aGUtbW9yYWwtY2FzZS1mb3ItY2FwaXRhbGlzbS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tb3JhbF9jYXNlX2NhcGl0YWxpc20mdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Tk5fUEEtQUZSLTIwMjQwNzE5Jm9sYz0zOTM4NFcDc3BjQgpmlTNummboyU0DUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.

This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.

This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

body:

| | |
---
|
---
| Freedom Riders Event Recap
---
We want to share the excitement and success of our recent event at the Republican National Committee (RNC) with you. The event was truly incredible, and we were overwhelmed by the support we received.
---
|
---
|
---
---
---
| We were honored to hear from some of the most dedicated pro-family advocates in our country. Our President, Terry Schilling, set the tone for the event with his inspiring words. We were also privileged to hear from Senator Roger Marshall (KS), and Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene (GA), and Riley Gaines, all of whom shared powerful messages about the importance of protecting women's sports and our children from body mutilating surgeries and hormone blockers. A special highlight of the event was the presence of Paul Sr. from Orange County Choppers and his wife. They brought a unique energy to the event and showcased their unwavering support for our cause. The moment that truly stood out was when Paul Sr. presented Riley Gaines with her custom motorcycle from Orange County Choppers. Riley was stunned by the craftsmanship of the bike and it served as a unique tribute to Riley's tireless efforts to protect women's sports.

---
|
---
| We are incredibly grateful to everyone who helped make this event a success. Your support allowed us to honor Riley in a meaningful way and to continue advocating for the protection of women's sports.

Peter, **When election analysts rate a race a “TOSS-UP,” it truly means it’s anyone’s game. ** The truth of the matter is _(thanks in large part to partisan gerrymandering!)_ that only a few contests ever make it on a “toss-up” list. So when we saw that a top analyst at _Sabato’s Crystal Ball_ rated SIX of the legislative chambers we’re targeting this year as toss-ups, we knew it was a big deal. **After those ratings were released, we saw a surge of donations to support this important work. But since we emailed you earlier this month about how critical these races are, we haven’t received a donation from you just yet.** [**We’re reaching out because there’s still a chance for you to join all the folks who are supporting this work right now. It will go a long way toward turning these “TOSS-UP” chambers into wins for fair maps. Can we count on you to chip in right away?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89156594/486379563/1763522771?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_julyfun_email_20240719-NDRC-Tier1-RaceRatingsReduxNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240719-NDRC-Tier1-RaceRatingsReduxNOR_&utm_campaign=julyfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM0NzFkMGFlLWRhNDUtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XLUkiDHCsMGCt-3ihbvOXZbhlPNk_6YwohvFFpQFtJA=) **The expert from _Sabato’s Crystal Ball_ listed the following state’s legislative chambers as “TOSS-UPs” – so here’s a quick analysis of what’s a stake in each:** **→ Arizona:** Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. **→ Michigan:** While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. **→ Minnesota:** Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, *only* the State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen from the Land of 10,000 Lakes this year. **→ New Hampshire:** It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. **→ Pennsylvania:** Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority *and* flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta. **Your urgent donation to the NDRC will help us ramp up our efforts in these critical races — and more across the country — so we can lock in some major victories for democracy this November and beyond.

clean_body: We’ve seen a surge of donations since we told you this big news: | Peter, When election analysts rate a race a “TOSS-UP,” it truly means it’s anyone’s game. The truth of the matter is (thanks in large part to partisan gerrymandering!) that only a few contests ever make it on a “toss-up” list. So when we saw that a top analyst at Sabato’s Crystal Ball rated SIX of the legislative chambers we’re targeting this year as toss-ups, we knew it was a big deal. After those ratings were released, we saw a surge of donations to support this important work. But since we emailed you earlier this month about how critical these races are, we haven’t received a donation from you just yet. = The expert from Sabato’s Crystal Ball listed the following state’s legislative chambers as “TOSS-UPs” – so here’s a quick analysis of what’s a stake in each: → Arizona: Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. → Michigan: While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. → Minnesota: Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, only the State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen from the Land of 10,000 Lakes this year. → New Hampshire: It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. → Pennsylvania: Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. Then, help us protect the GOP majority so that we can continue to get things done with a [small contribution to the NH Senate Republicans here! (secure link)](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0yNTI3NjcxNzkyNzU2MDcwMTI1JmM9cDBhOCZlPTE5MjgmYj0xMzQzNTEzMTI5JmQ9cTRzM3o5dg==.TLwTZ5tYxnoWlTewteewSyz-hjlEYR0yhN8H-6k1jyk) Thank you, NH Senate Republicans

| Sens. Jeb Bradley & Sharon Carson: Republicans get the job done for NH families

---
| | | IT’S HARD not to get cynical about our national politics these days. But here in New Hampshire, Senate Republicans have led the way to get things done for New Hampshire working families. We are proud of what we’ve done this year to keep New Hampshire the best place to live, work, and raise a family. Our top priority is always to keep Granite State families safe. For several years, we have worked to fix the state’s broken bail system. This year, we have finally gotten meaningful bail reform over the finish line. While no one will be denied bail simply because they cannot afford it, we have set up a system that requires violent and repeat offenders to go in front of a judge or magistrate before being released. We’ve taken proactive steps to address our nation’s border crisis by making sure the Northern Border Alliance has the tools and resources to stop illegal immigration into New Hampshire and the resulting drug smuggling and human trafficking that comes with it. Lack of affordable housing continues to be a major hurdle, both for New Hampshire families and our state’s economy. Last year, we dedicated $35 million to the Affordable Housing Fund, an additional $10 million to InvestNH, $5 million for Housing Champions, and $10 million in state aid for homelessness programs. This year we worked to lower bureaucratic hurdles that stifle housing development and allocated $2.5 million to increase rates for shelter programs. We also protected the rights of property owners by prohibiting squatters’ rights. During the last legislative session, the Senate led the way in passing more than $500 million in property tax relief for cities and towns. We built on that record this session, sending nearly $2.7 billion in state aid to cities and towns, including $683 million in new state aid. That includes the $169 million increase to local school districts under our Student-Centered Education Funding Formula, $90 million for water and wastewater infrastructure and treatment programs, $40 million for municipal roads and bridges, and $260 million in local Rooms and Meals revenues over the biennium, double the amount going back to towns from just four years ago. We stood up for vulnerable New Hampshire children, putting new protections in place for kids placed in the state’s care, increasing penalties for child pornography and violations of privacy involving minors, and banned life-altering and irreversible gender reassignment surgery for children. We kept our promise to fight for New Hampshire families, passing a Parents Bill of Rights that would guarantee every parent has a right to know what’s going on with their children in New Hampshire schools. We voted to protect girls by allowing schools to distinguish bathrooms, locker rooms and sports teams based on biological sex. We passed legislation to provide a clear complaint and appeals process for parents who believe school materials are inappropriate. We also expanded eligibility for New Hampshire’s wildly successful Education Freedom Account program, which is already helping 4,200 working families choose the best educational path for their children. We will always protect the New Hampshire Advantage. We blocked big spending bills that would force us into an income tax, sales tax, increased property taxes, or the return of donor towns. We will never tax our way to prosperity. Instead, we passed a balanced budget that has produced a revenue surplus of $146.5 million through the end of June. This fiscal discipline and common-sense policy making has helped make New Hampshire not only the freest state in the nation, but the safest, the healthiest, the best for economic opportunity, and the best for child well-being in the nation. There are always new challenges ahead. Senate Republicans stand ready to face them with the same dedication and commitment that we’ve shown over the past four years. We will never take for granted the trust that Granite Staters have placed in us to get things done for New Hampshire working families. Senate President Jeb Bradley (R-Wolfeboro) represents District 3. Senate Majority Leader Sharon Carson (R-Londonderry) represents District 14.

body:
#

Team -
Today, we hope you’ll allow us to share five reasons why your $5 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC is so important.
1️⃣ **On average, about 120 people die every day from gun violence in our country.** This is a heartbreaking statistic, but it’s one that we CAN change if we continue our work to help pass commonsense gun safety legislation nationwide.
2️⃣ **Gun violence is the NUMBER ONE cause of death for children in our nation.** Not car crashes. Not cancer. It’s guns. Our children deserve so much better than this, and we cannot rest until we create a future free from gun violence so that they can thrive.
3️⃣ **The Republican National Convention just ended.** While there was a lot of talk about violent crime at the convention, we heard nothing on Republicans’ plans to prevent guns from falling into the wrong hands. We need your support to make sure that gun safety champions defeat extreme gun lobby-backed candidates up and down the ballot this November.
4️⃣ **Donald Trump just chose JD Vance as his running mate.** Throughout their careers, both Trump and Vance have proven that they will put the gun lobby’s desires before the safety of the American people. We can’t let them take back the White House—we must win on Election Day.
5️⃣ **Our fundraising has slowed down this month, but the NRA has been making a comeback.** A recent report of fundraising numbers showed that the NRA outraised the gun safety movement during the month of May. We must keep our fundraising on track to show the gun lobby that our movement is stronger than ever.
We hope that these five reasons demonstrate the importance of your contribution to GIFFORDS PAC.

| [**Here's what we cover in this episode:**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=dd32c47953&e=567664f14c)
1. **Rapid Reaction to Donald Trump's RNC Speech:** We provide immediate analysis of Trump's emotional speech, where he opens up about the assassination attempt against him. This speech reveals a different side of Trump. How long will the softer side of Trump last?

2. **On the Ground Report from the RNC:** We welcome Mike Garofalo from Victory News, who joins us live from the convention hall with an insider's perspective on the atmosphere and reactions within the RNC.

[**→ STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=23c3ee3905&e=567664f14c)

3. **Election Insights:** It’s looking more likely that Joe Biden will soon exit the race. We discuss the timing of this potential exit and speculate on who might step in to take his place. Mark Halperin suggests there could be an open convention where the Democrats will choose their nominee, but Mark and Krysty have their own thoughts on this scenario.

4. **The Road Ahead:** Mark warns not to assume that this election is a done deal for Trump. We delve into the complexities and uncertainties still ahead in this election cycle.

As always, we’d love for you to like, subscribe, and share the podcast with your friends and family.

Don’t forget to [subscribe to our YouTube channel](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=f1f0074047&e=567664f14c) for more great content, and check out our merchandise or contribute to the podcast at [nodoubtaboutitpodcast.com](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ef385641a8&e=567664f14c).

End Unfair Property Tax has submitted a total of 40,905 signatures to the Secretary of State's office, far exceeding the required 31,164 signatures needed to get our measure to end North Dakota’s unfair property tax on the November ballot!

In his latest bid for reelection, Donald Trump delivered the longest nomination acceptance speech in US history, peppered with so many falsehoods that it's impossible to fact-check them all in a single article. Perhaps that was the point. His strategy relies on overwhelming the public with misinformation, banking on the notion that sheer volume will bury the truth. We must see through this vile rhetoric and reject the hate he spreads. To that end, I debunk four of his biggest lies in this article, on immigration, on crime, on foreign policy, and on climate and the economy. **Let 's Address This.**

## **1\. Demonizing Immigrants**
Trump's favorite scare tactic throughout his speech was to claim there's an "invasion of immigrants killing hundreds of thousands of people a year." Let's break down this blatant falsehood:
* There's no "invasion." Notwithstanding the absurdity of labeling immigrants as "invaders," [undocumented crossings are at a three year ](https://substack.com/redirect/eb9a78a8-8eeb-43f3-bf66-d3428c74fc92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[low](https://substack.com/redirect/eb9a78a8-8eeb-43f3-bf66-d3428c74fc92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
* Immigrants are not "killing hundreds of thousands of people a year." In reality, all murders in America combined total around 21,500 annually. Trump fabricated data to fear monger and hope it wins him votes.
* Far from record crime rates as Trump alleged, [America's murder rates are at historic lows](https://substack.com/redirect/082e587e-aa31-465b-94d4-c891d81f564f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and falling. Again, the facts are inconvenient to Trump so he makes up his own alternative facts as he goes along.
* Trump never mentions that murder rates are [40% higher in red states than in blue states](https://substack.com/redirect/d9c7c825-7583-49bc-aa7c-3a0e022781b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and 8 of the top 10 states with highest murder rates are red states. This is in part due to failed "tough on crime" policies that red states espouse. It's also due to the lack of meaningful gun safety legislation in red states. And, it's due to the lack of basic social welfare programs in many red states, forcing people into poverty and desperation. Trump demonizes immigrants to avoid dealing with failed Republican policies.
* Likewise, Trump's claim that "_I have no problem with immigrants, but they have to do it legally_ " is a lie. In reality, Trump is changing what legal immigration is, and he's opposed to non-white immigration. For example, asylum is legal immigration--but here's the entire timeline of [Trump's repeated efforts to ban asylum altogether](https://substack.com/redirect/2a099340-9c9b-436a-9895-50a39022c9ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Likewise, Trump is on record that he wants [more white immigrants from 'nice' countries like Norway](https://substack.com/redirect/050c0aaa-2d8c-497e-9008-0329f73e1b04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but condemns immigrants from _"[sh*thole countries](https://substack.com/redirect/8b08d3b0-eb36-4613-a94d-65e745a6f6ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),_" i.e. his pejorative for Haiti and African countries. He claims he will support immigration reform, but when this Congress had a bipartisan immigration bill--[Trump told GOP to kill it](https://substack.com/redirect/4a1ceaac-34b0-4620-923f-2fc2641c5796?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Finally, immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have significantly lower crime rates than do born U.S. citizens. This has in fact always been the case. You are statistically safer living next to an immigrant than you are living next to a born U.S. citizen. In fact, a study over a 150 year period found that [immigrants have ](https://substack.com/redirect/25bdcd6d-e263-4f12-b117-8818ba24e2b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[never](https://substack.com/redirect/25bdcd6d-e263-4f12-b117-8818ba24e2b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[had a higher crime rate than born U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/25bdcd6d-e263-4f12-b117-8818ba24e2b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Trump has long demonized immigrants with outright demonization and disinformation, he his RNC speech was on brand with bigotry.

## **2\. Fabricating Crime Data**
Trump repeatedly claimed that crime is at historic highs in the United States, and low in nations like Venezuela and El Salvador, because allegedly those nations are sending their criminals to the United States. Literally none of this is true.
Crime rates in the United States have fallen to historic lows. In fact, FBI data reports that [violent crime in the United States is at near 50 year lows](https://substack.com/redirect/c1c95434-2a57-4f99-ad76-1741a7f2bc86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Moreover, not only is there [zero reliable data that crime is dropping in Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/92472ac9-2b55-405b-8081-ac2109e7c938?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for example, there's also zero evidence that Venezuela or any country is "sending us their criminals." As mentioned earlier, immigrants have had lower crime rates than US citizens for the entirety of the last 150 years that this data has been tracked.
Meanwhile, while study after study shows that [white supremacy terrorism is the single greatest threat to American safety and security](https://substack.com/redirect/819814e1-67e6-4388-b9ba-8b743694a1f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Trump never once even hinted at that fact. Instead, he continued to weaponize racism, conveniently ignoring the white male conservative extremist who attempted to assassinate him with a legally purchased firearm just a week prior. Where's the action on gun safety? Even as guns are the leading cause of death for children in America, Donald Trump takes no action to stop the mass violence and death.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ec80abde-f858-4f1e-a769-3ab29c54b6ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In a desperate ploy to win over Black and Latino voters, Trump peddles the age-old lie that "illegal aliens" are taking their jobs. This is a classic white supremacist tactic: sow division among people of color to prevent unity against systemic oppression. It's a trick as old as time, and we must reject it outright. In fact, a recent study showed that [immigrants contributed a whopping $7 Trillion to the economy](https://substack.com/redirect/95811b77-dd90-4d7c-8b6c-5cfaa95ce3b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Far from costing anyone a job, the facts show that immigrants are a literal gold mine of economic prosperity for the communities in which they reside.
Finally, remember Trump's racist rhetoric isn't just divisive; it's strategically selective. He warns of an ongoing "invasion" from Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, yet never once mentions the over [648,000 (mostly white) undocumented immigrants from Canada, Europe, and Oceania in the US](https://substack.com/redirect/654f66b9-5c2d-4ac5-aaca-07bb5d778db0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Why? Because, again, this isn't about border security; it's about advancing white supremacy.

## **3\. Failed Foreign Policy**
Trump's self-congratulations for being "tough" on the Taliban ring hollow when you remember he [forced the Afghan government to release 5,000 Taliban terrorists from prison](https://substack.com/redirect/f0369dcb-8d09-479c-b9d1-88027bb76bf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) without securing a single concession. Many of these terrorists went on to participate in attacks. This isn't strength--it's reckless endangerment.
Trump goes on to claim he was tough on Russia, China, and North Korea. None of this is, of course, accurate. North Korea produced [more ICBMs under Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/9ab2df4a-85d2-4eae-b64e-c4662bf28e87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than under Obama, and according to experts became even more dangerous than before. [Russia successfully interfered with our elections](https://substack.com/redirect/f28eedce-03e1-4b14-ab9c-1ea1e992dd58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) without facing any meaningful accountability. And the trade deal Trump signed with China [is recognized as an abject failure](https://substack.com/redirect/e9503b52-16e0-4c3b-a3c8-1bf420950bba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3c664ed0-cb65-44e9-bc73-6746fc8f09fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Finally, Trump's repeated reference to Hamas's war crimes on 10/7, with zero regard to the at least tens of thousands of innocent Palestinians killed in indiscriminate bombing since, sends a clear message that he will only continue the violence. Trump ignored the ICJ prosecution, the ICC prosecution, and the UN reports describing the killing of Palestinians as "extermination,"--and promised to send ‪even more arms to bomb Palestine.‬ In other words, a vote for Donald Trump is a vote for continued genocide of the Palestinian people, without any real plan for peace or upholding justice.

## **4\. Inviting Economic and Climate Catastrophe**
And last but not least, Donald Trump's remarks made crystal clear that he is inviting economic and climate disaster. He repeatedly declared "_drill baby drill_ ," in a reference to expanding drilling for oil--something that climate scientists tell us is both devastating to our environment but also unnecessary with newer green energy technologies. Notwithstanding that [we are currently experiencing the hottest 12 month period on record](https://substack.com/redirect/caa26d02-7422-460f-8a57-ee8581f9fcc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Trump's anti-climate platform will doom our country and planet for generations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e968b0f7-f57e-422c-9dc4-fa920f30542a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump repeatedly promised to cut taxes once more. In reality, these are tax cuts for billionaires--made worse as our nation suffers through the worst wealth and income inequality since the Great Depression. We already know Trump's 2017 tax plan was [majorly skewed to benefit the rich and screw over working people](https://substack.com/redirect/102b8796-e8c0-4d6b-b083-d5f760ad1c0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This was predicted and it happened to no one's surprise. Now, a [new study documents](https://substack.com/redirect/5acb070a-7f9d-473b-b165-08035f296897?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) how Trump's potential 2025 tax plan would raise taxes on working families and raise tariffs about $1500 a year per average working family.
In short, Donald Trump's policies guarantee economic, environmental, and social catastrophe.

## In Conclusion
Donald Trump's lies are not mere words; they're dangerous deceptions designed to enact policies to divide and destroy. His presidency was marked by a consistent pattern of dishonesty, racism, and policy failures, and nothing has changed since he was voted out of office. Make no mistake, his return to the White House with a [Project 2025 agenda will invite fascism to America](https://substack.com/redirect/9ed4ec6a-8e19-4eee-b6df-6eccc4186635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And while this short article did not capture every lie he put forth in his RNC speech, it presents enough data to demonstrate that Donald Trump is not to be trusted with the office of the presidency--not if we care about the economy, the environment, immigration reform, reproductive health access, and government accountability.
We must see through Trumps's smokescreen of lies, understand the real threats to our nation's future, and work with actual productive policy for economic, social, and climate justice. Reject the rhetoric. Reject the hate. Reject Donald Trump. Our country deserves better.

Trump demonizes immigrants to avoid dealing with failed Republican policies. Likewise, Trump's claim that "I have no problem with immigrants, but they have to do it legally " is a lie. In reality, Trump is changing what legal immigration is, and he's opposed to non-white immigration. For example, asylum is legal immigration--but here's the entire timeline of . Likewise, Trump is on record that he wants , but condemns immigrants from "," i.e. his pejorative for Haiti and African countries. He claims he will support immigration reform, but when this Congress had a bipartisan immigration bill--. Finally, immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have significantly lower crime rates than do born U.S. citizens. This has in fact always been the case. You are statistically safer living next to an immigrant than you are living next to a born U.S. citizen. In fact, a study over a 150 year period found that . Trump has long demonized immigrants with outright demonization and disinformation, he his RNC speech was on brand with bigotry. 2\. Fabricating Crime Data Trump repeatedly claimed that crime is at historic highs in the United States, and low in nations like Venezuela and El Salvador, because allegedly those nations are sending their criminals to the United States. Literally none of this is true. Crime rates in the United States have fallen to historic lows. In fact, FBI data reports that . Moreover, not only is there , for example, there's also zero evidence that Venezuela or any country is "sending us their criminals." As mentioned earlier, immigrants have had lower crime rates than US citizens for the entirety of the last 150 years that this data has been tracked. Meanwhile, while study after study shows that , Trump never once even hinted at that fact. Instead, he continued to weaponize racism, conveniently ignoring the white male conservative extremist who attempted to assassinate him with a legally purchased firearm just a week prior. Where's the action on gun safety? Even as guns are the leading cause of death for children in America, Donald Trump takes no action to stop the mass violence and death. | | ---|---|--- In a desperate ploy to win over Black and Latino voters, Trump peddles the age-old lie that "illegal aliens" are taking their jobs. This is a classic white supremacist tactic: sow division among people of color to prevent unity against systemic oppression. It's a trick as old as time, and we must reject it outright. In fact, a recent study showed that . Far from costing anyone a job, the facts show that immigrants are a literal gold mine of economic prosperity for the communities in which they reside. Finally, remember Trump's racist rhetoric isn't just divisive; it's strategically selective. He warns of an ongoing "invasion" from Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, yet never once mentions the over . Why? Because, again, this isn't about border security; it's about advancing white supremacy. 3\. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vslot2uWNJ

I am fearful that legal persecution will intensify
against Americans holding to faith-based values

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oslot2uWNJ

Fellow
American,

There is
a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me
worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the
Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and
signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only
intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Are you
concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our
founding-Religious Liberty?

In
addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous
examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v.
BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL
RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few
examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to
faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to
their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act,
brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal
Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and
organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex
marriage failed.

This has
the potential to only intensify legal persecution against
individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to
faith-based values.

The
American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to
preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation
for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty,
Community, and Life.

Whether
it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield
after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a
cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I
am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who
wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?

Please
share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning
religious liberty in America.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63401214:slot2uWNJ:m:3:2627245898:0DB0274538665A55E55E28FFCC85BE20:r

Thank you
for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

© 2023 American Cornerstone Institute, All rights reserved.

**Here’s what happened:**
❗ **All but two Republicans voted against** a nonbinding bill that would have affirmed protections for abortion.

❗ Senate Democrats introduced bills to support training healthcare professionals in abortion, protect physicians who provide legal abortions, and reinforce the right to travel across state lines for reproductive healthcare. **All were blocked by Republicans.**

❗ Senator Patty Murray called for a straightforward vote on whether women should have the basic freedom to make their own healthcare decisions. **Republicans said no.**
We can’t afford to stay silent at this stage. Over 60% of Americans believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases, and even among Republican women, a majority support access to abortions in cases of emergencies, rape, or incest.
That’s why President Biden and Senate Democrats are fighting _tooth and nail_ to protect reproductive rights across the country. But with the GOP on a mission to strip away these rights, we need your help to keep our Democratic majorities and ensure reproductive freedom for all.

Do you believe Democrats MUST do everything in their power to protect reproductive rights? | | ---|--- Here’s what happened: ❗ All but two Republicans voted against a nonbinding bill that would have affirmed protections for abortion. ❗ Senate Democrats introduced bills to support training healthcare professionals in abortion, protect physicians who provide legal abortions, and reinforce the right to travel across state lines for reproductive healthcare. All were blocked by Republicans. ❗ Senator Patty Murray called for a straightforward vote on whether women should have the basic freedom to make their own healthcare decisions. Republicans said no. We can’t afford to stay silent at this stage. Over 60% of Americans believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases, and even among Republican women, a majority support access to abortions in cases of emergencies, rape, or incest. That’s why President Biden and Senate Democrats are fighting tooth and nail to protect reproductive rights across the country. But with the GOP on a mission to strip away these rights, we need your help to keep our Democratic majorities and ensure reproductive freedom for all. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
What kind of president do we want for the next four years?
#
Derek –
I recently joined President Biden on the campaign trail, and I have to tell you: People were thrilled to see him at every stop.
**There is only ONE person in this country who has ever kicked Trump's a** in an election, and that is President Biden. That’s our guy. I’m proud to stand with him, and I’m asking you to join me.**
**[Will you pitch in a few bucks to power President Biden’s reelection campaign against Donald Trump? He can’t keep going without your grassroots support.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240719?refcode=em20240719-9229&refcode2=jbp_em_20240719_b1_jkf_jkf_fl&akid=9229%2E434096%2EG_0DbV)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240719?amount=5&refcode=em20240719-9229&refcode2=jbp_em_20240719_b1_jkf_jkf_fl&akid=9229%2E434096%2EG_0DbV)**
I refuse to join the vultures on Joe’s shoulder following the debate.
No one knows more than me that a rough debate is not the sum total of a person and their record. Ninety minutes on stage can’t erase the Biden administration’s three and a half years of accomplishment after accomplishment after accomplishment.
**The reality is there’s a very stark choice before us, Derek. What kind of president do we want for the next four years?**
_Choice #1:_ Joe Biden, who has created more jobs than any president in history, passed historic bipartisan gun safety legislation, lowered prescription drug costs, and signed into law once-in-a-generation investments in our nation’s infrastructure.
_Choice #2:_ Donald Trump, who is obsessed with the past, and a twice-impeached former president with 34 felony convictions.
**[I know which side I’m on, and I need people like you to join me. Too much is at stake to sit on the sidelines at a moment like this. So please Derek, pitch in $5 to reelect President Biden, defeat Donald Trump, and keep our country moving forward.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240719?refcode=em20240719-9229&refcode2=jbp_em_20240719_b1_jkf_jkf_fl&akid=9229%2E434096%2EG_0DbV)**
Thank you for everything you do. It’s up to us to save our democracy. 🙏
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A fresh coat of paint on rotten wood
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
What the far right ACTUALLY stands for

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2272%2E4032634%2EeVCRqn)
---
At their convention this week in Milwaukee, Republicans tried to slap a fresh coat of paint on a bunch of rotten wood. Let’s cut through their spin and remember what the far right actually stands for (this is only the tip of the ugly iceberg):
* Passing a national abortion ban
* Giving massive tax breaks to billionaires and giant corporations
* Rolling back the progress we’ve made in the fight against climate change
* Cutting Social Security and Medicare
* Repealing the Affordable Care Act
* Letting Big Pharma rip off people who are trying to get their prescriptions filled
* Shielding wealthy tax cheats by slashing IRS enforcement resources
* Oh, and supporting Donald Trump as he says he’d be a dictator on Day 1

Here’s one more piece that Republicans went out of their way to celebrate this week, with big signs saying “Mass Deportation Now”: rounding up 11 million people at gunpoint and deporting them. It’s sickening. But none of that needs to happen. We have the power to stop the radical right’s appalling agenda in its tracks. If Democrats win this November, we can make positive change for our nation:
* Ensuring reproductive freedom nationwide
* Taxing billionaires and giant corporations to fund opportunity for all of our kids
* Making more progress in the fight against climate change
* Protecting and expanding Social Security
* Standing up for health care as a basic human right
* Continuing to bring down prescription drug costs
* Continuing to crack down on wealthy tax cheats
* Defending our democracy by protecting the right to vote and the right to have that vote counted

Along with passing an immigration package that includes border security and a path to citizenship for Dreamers and their families, for essential workers, for longtime residents, and for those who want to serve our country and for their families. I’m running for re-election to get all this done and more — because working families need bold action now, and because we’ve got to stop MAGA Republicans’ outrageous plans from becoming devastating realities. [**But I can’t do this alone. Add your name to say that you’re committed to stopping the GOP’s radical agenda in 2024, and that you’re ready to keep pushing for big, structural change in 2025 and beyond.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-RNC/?source=EMZ21N_GOP_E_20240719_V1S1&t=8&akid=2272%2E4032634%2EeVCRqn) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

subject: The Supreme Court obliterated 40 years of precedent. This is how Congress can make it right.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Last month, the Supreme Court overturned Chevron deference, the foundation of modern administrative law. It guides courts to defer to the expertise of federal agencies when dealing with ambiguities in the specifics of regulations. For example, judges, not experts, may now be forced to handle technical questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about equipment use or complex questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about how weather patterns impact downwind air pollution.

In throwing it out, they obliterated 40 years of precedent and upended our entire system of reasonable regulatory checks on corporate power.

60% of regulations [https://www.arnoldporter.com/en/perspectives/advisories/2024/07/when-apa-claims-accrue-under-corner-post] – including those protecting the environment, worker’s rights, and public health – rely on Chevron deference. Each and every one, no matter how long-standing, could now be under attack.

Tell Congress: Protect common-sense regulations. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=aEdonmlzGY4Bnvsj+0+JapazI5qOtT1Qvvv3lcxeToreTA8UK/UX5g+VP7zhnCpxDetQoyiCErNvyQVIZFckfD73LIhZDz7MgiNpkXJr6QHKe5fbQcc+0mhmHtQhlsyPbDXh8pyYkRGa56JAgIuteA==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143]

The far-right Supreme Court is sabotaging the public interest. As Justice Kagan remarked [https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/23pdf/22-451_7m58.pdf] , “the majority turns itself into the country’s administrative czar," giving unaccountable judges an effective veto [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/elena-kagan-dissent-supreme-court-john-roberts-chevron-disaster.html] over experts.

TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to codify the Chevron doctrine and protect public interest over unchecked greed. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=aEdonmlzGY4Bnvsj+0+JapazI5qOtT1Qvvv3lcxeToreTA8UK/UX5g+VP7zhnCpxDetQoyiCErNvyQVIZFckfD73LIhZDz7MgiNpkXJr6QHKe5fbQcc+0mhmHtQhlsyPbDXh8pyYkRGa56JAgIuteA==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=aEdonmlzGY4Bnvsj+0+JapazI5qOtT1Qvvv3lcxeToreTA8UK/UX5g+VP7zhnCpxDetQoyiCErNvyQVIZFckfD73LIhZDz7MgiNpkXJr6QHKe5fbQcc+0mhmHtQhlsyPbDXh8pyYkRGa56JAgIuteA==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Wait! One more thing–

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future.

body:
I know you have better things to do than read these emails, but I hope you’ll give me just a minute of your time.

Hey — I know you have better things to do than read these emails, but I hope you’ll give me just a minute of your time. I’m in the fight of my life, and the odds against our campaign keep stacking up. I’m running against an **ultra-wealthy, handpicked opponent** who can write his campaign million-dollar checks at the drop of a hat. Experts have ranked Montana’s Senate race a **toss-up** , and with **recent polls locked in a tie** , it’s anyone’s to win. And a super PAC just made a **NEW seven-figure ad buy** in Montana to help my out-of-stater opponent win. **Look, the sky won’t fall if you don’t chip in—and I’ll never trick you into donatin****g. Ken Tingley, a journalist for whom I have utmost regard, [wrote about Stefanik this morning on his Substack. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f63df4d4-8a42-4682-bb72-0dad0c3f2b75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Out of respect for Ken and his readers, when I realized my reply was lengthy, I curtailed my remarks there and decided to write a separate column here.
Ken Tingley wrote that my Republican opponent, Elise Stefanik, continues to perpetuate a reality that is not true.
The Republicans, who have now shape-shifted and have formed a distinct party rightly called, "MAGA", have a fluid relationship with truth. That fluidity serves them well in an era in which federal judges such as Aileen Cannon [denies that a special counsel is constitutional](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/21040e73-fdd5-45a2-a004-58e7b89f6051?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or SCOTUS determines that [federal agencies essentially have no means of regulating](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7a7ed1d9-d917-4a8e-a4c3-e5136ed2ed61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the absence of Chevron deferences.
MAGAs have firmly moved on to a totally new style of electioneering, largely centered on legal and administrative aggression. It's largely irrelevant whether there is substance to the claims they file in court or in other agencies, as they have now done with a claim against me with the FEC. People who have only a casual relationship with truth seem to be very quick to rush into legal proceedings to accuse others of wrongdoing. It's like that game of diversion that some adults play with kids (and with dogs, actually), where they act like they point and act like they are going to throw the ball in one direction, and quickly divert in another direction after the kid (or dog) has raced off.
As with so many things in the 2024 election cycle, I firmly believe that Democrats are floundering by trying to run a race like this is the Obama-McCain race of 2008 or the Obama-Romney race of 2012. Back then, fact-checking made sense. In 2024, fact-checking, while it serves to balance non-MAGAs, serves to simply add debris to the tornadic-like fury of political discourse.
As the Democratic Candidate who is opposing Stefanik in her 6th race for Congress, I become disoriented when I ask voters who say they like Stefanik for specifics on their support. For example, I spoke with a woman in Holland Patent who said she likes Stefanik because of her support for the military. Yet, had Stefanik and other lawmakers collaborated more closely with VA officials, they might have averted the[ historic budget shortfall](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4d7f996b-49df-496f-a150-54e0a815e185?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that threatens to severely impact services to veterans. Project 2025 promises to accelerate the application process for veterans' disability applications. Read into that: the process will go faster because very few medical or psychological conditions will qualify. And if we consider how many veterans transition into federal jobs after active duty, it is disingenuous to support a plan that makes sweeping reductions to the federal workforce. Veterans who might have otherwise enjoyed a lifetime of service will find themselves unable to get hired by the federal agencies when they separate from active duty.
Let me be clear: I need people like Ken Tingley to fact-check and call out when there are lies. But I'm wondering if fact-checking hasn't gone the way of the beeper and the Sony Walkman.
While we are busy fact-checking, they are two steps ahead of us, working in state houses to impose abortion bans, and limit voting rights. Or they are seated at laptops, e-filing complaints in courts and administrative agencies to, at a minimum, distract and gain headlines. The truth or substance of their claims is irrelevant. The whole purpose is to add to the tornado that will pick up the proverbial house and set it down in some new, MAGA-Wizard-driven Oz. Pay no attention to the Orange Man behind the curtain. We aren't in Kansas anymore.
Nor are we in 2008 anymore. And even if we found another Obama, this race in 2024 would be litigious. BTW, I was asked about Obama a few weeks ago. "How much do you think the Democratic Party had to pay the Hawaii Department of Health to produce that birth certificate?" This question, from someone who has a regular seat in front of a microphone, with a considerable daily following.
Back in the Obama-McCain race of 2008 or the Obama-Romney race of 2102, fact-checking made sense. In 2024, fact-checking, while it serves to balance non-MAGAs, serves to simply add debris to the tornadic-like fury of political discourse.
By September of 2020, there were [245 election-related lawsuits filed](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c51483b3-cb5c-47a5-a0f1-856455a87c2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in varying levels of the ballot. After the election, there were [61 lawsuits filed by Trump](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d287ab9c-9bef-4225-818f-d6dbb361cd91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Trump was stunned when judges he had appointed determined that the claims were, as Biden said at Merrick Garland's nomination announcement, "without any merit".
But the success or failure of the lawsuits didn't matter, just like the truth doesn't matter to the MAGAs. What they accomplished was turmoil, doubt, and that tornado that I mentioned above. I know. I'm caught in the vortex as we speak.
Forget the Blue Wave that we have been counting on. Look for the Litigation Tsunami. It's already here. My campaign has been hit by several suits or complaints. While I am not even a blip on the screen for the state- and national-level Democratic Parties or PACs, the New York State Republican Party scarcely lets a week pass without sweeping me into another complaint.
It's 2024. Get ready to hear, "All rise. This Court is in session."

# The RNC is over and all we got was a
Project 2025 VP pick and divisive rhetoric
---

This pivotal moment in our nation's history saw brave women and men gathered to demand equality and justice for women. The Seneca Falls Conference was more than just a meeting – it was a declaration of courage and a powerful statement that women's voices matter in this country. It ignited a movement that has led to significant advancements in gender equality, including the right to vote, greater workplace protections, and increased representation in leadership positions. But now those rights have taken a hit, and there are those who wish to roll them back even further, including right here in Montana. Abortion rights will directly be on the ballot in November, and Christi Jacobsen is doing her best to ensure codifying the right to choose fails. So, on this anniversary, let us honor the legacy of the Seneca Falls Conference by reaffirming our commitment to fighting for women's rights. In 2008, my Humvee was hit by a bomb in Afghanistan. I was covered in diesel fuel and burned alive. I was saved by the words of my gunner, who said **_" Sir, I've got you!"_**

They gave me hope, the kind of hope needed to make it through years of surgeries that left my face permanently scarred. In hindsight, that day was a blessing in more ways than you could imagine. Though my body and face were permanently scarred, my soul was saved that day. As President Trump now knows all too well, coming so close to death has a way of changing a person's life and renewing one's faith in God. I was willing to lay down my life for my country, and to this day I still am. I was proud to serve in Afghanistan and I will be proud to serve again alongside President Trump.

**_America, I 've got you!_** Friend, I'm in the middle of a tough election. I won't lie, this isn't easy. Peter
In California, 178,322 acres have already burned this year as a result of wildfires.
You read that correctly. 178,322 acres, gone. Compared to the 7,800 we saw this time last year. It’s devastating.
It is more important than ever that we elect firefighter Joe Kerr to Congress.
As a long-time firefighter, Joe has put his life on the line to keep Orange County families safe, responding to every significant disaster in Orange County over the last three decades - inside burning buildings, putting out fires, responding to disasters, and saving lives.
He is the only candidate in the nation uniquely poised to lead the conversation on wildfire prevention and keeping Californians safe and insured.
In fact, he worked alongside the Newsom Administration and the California Professional Firefighters in a groundbreaking wildfire prevention project. The program deployed over 1,000 AI-powered wildfire cameras—an innovation developed by UCSD. These cameras detect and monitor fires from their earliest stages, providing critical early warnings that have already saved countless lives, billions of dollars, and millions of acres of California’s wildlands. This technology is a game-changer, and Joe's leadership in this effort is a testament to his forward-thinking approach.
He has made it clear he intends to continue the fight against wildfires on the federal level by securing funding for this technology, along with additional firefighter resources, tools, and protections, while fighting to protect homeowner’s insurance.

# [Tell Trump you’re not fooled by his “softer tone”](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcaa8fa5d-63af-4b71-ad00-aaf6752e415d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | _**Fight or Fold? Is the Republican Party missing an opportunity? **_By Sean Feucht
---
| | _Are we ignoring President Trump's battle cry to fight, and instead pandering to RNC party bosses' obsession with Unity?_ America is teetering. We're on the edge of a cliff on so many fronts. Economically, Americans are hurting. It's hard to afford groceries, hard to afford a home, hard to afford a life. Fewer and fewer people are waking up to the American dream. The multi-front attack against President Trump came to a head on Saturday night in Butler, Pennsylvania, when an assassin's bullet missed it's mark by millimeters. As Trump rose to his feet, blood running down his face, he raised a fist in defiance and shouted... unity? No--FIGHT! Trump's courage is contagious. It filled Trump's millions of supporters across the country with hope, and his opponents in the media with petty jealousy. Why then is the RNC Convention not focusing on fighting for conservative values? clean_body: | | | | | Fight or Fold? Is the Republican Party missing an opportunity? By Sean Feucht | | Are we ignoring President Trump's battle cry to fight, and instead pandering to RNC party bosses' obsession with Unity? America is teetering. We're on the edge of a cliff on so many fronts. Economically, Americans are hurting. It's hard to afford groceries, hard to afford a home, hard to afford a life. Fewer and fewer people are waking up to the American dream. The multi-front attack against President Trump came to a head on Saturday night in Butler, Pennsylvania, when an assassin's bullet missed it's mark by millimeters. As Trump rose to his feet, blood running down his face, he raised a fist in defiance and shouted... unity? No--FIGHT! Trump's courage is contagious. It filled Trump's millions of supporters across the country with hope, and his opponents in the media with petty jealousy. Friend -- In the midst of the political turbulence swirling around us, it is important to hold fast to those universal principles which govern the world in which we live. Human beings are not animals, and we are capable of transforming our relationship to nature in profound ways, which benefit both humanity and nature. In order to do this, we must humble ourselves and study the principles by which our universe was created. Exploration of space is one crucial aspect of that effort. Saturday, July 20 marks the 55th anniversary of the first steps of human beings on the moon. How did we get there? Why did Lyndon LaRouche say that a 40 years program to colonize Mars would increase the standard of living for the American people by an order of magnitude? Join us tonight at 8pm!

#
Peter,
You know Elon Musk.
You know he’s arguably the richest man on earth. You know that over the last few years he’s moved further and further to the right. You might even know that he and his Silicon Valley friends have begun to take the side of Putin in his illegal invasion of Ukraine, threatening the safety and security of our NATO allies.
But what you might not have heard — because this just happened recently — is that **Elon Musk committed to contributing $45 MILLION EACH MONTH** to a new pro-Trump Super PAC.
**$45 million** every month to isolate the United States and our allies. **$45 million** for Project 2025. **$45 million** to consolidate the entire federal government under the complete control of one man. **$45 million every month from now until Election Day for Trump.**
It’s a staggering amount, and we’ll be completely honest with you — VoteVets has never raised or spent that much money in an election cycle, let alone in support of or against a single candidate in one month.

#

Peter —
As you read this email, Ruben Gallego is losing momentum in Arizona.
And before we get too far, we need to ask you: [**Can you make a donation of $5 to help Ruben fight back against Kari Lake and the MAGA-right and WIN this race?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240719-1-exp&t=1&akid=2637%2E734936%2EEbZz4q)

If you need to hear more, please — let us explain.
For months, we’ve led Kari Lake. We’ve outraised Kari Lake. We’ve outworked Kari Lake. But over the last several weeks we’ve seen our momentum fall off dramatically.
It started when Kari Lake went up with attack ads in Arizona. It compounded when the NRSC announced they were joining her on a massive $10 million ad buy in Arizona. And it’s taken a deep, deep effect over the last two weeks.
The first warning sign was a leaked NRSC poll showing Kari Lake up by a point over Ruben. Then another poll came, showing Ruben and Kari tied. Pollsters and analysts started taking notice, flipping their projection in our race and projecting Kari Lake to win.
Most recently, after Kari Lake directly addressed the RNC this week, a fresh poll showed her leading Ruben — 44% Lake, 43% Gallego.
All eyes are on Arizona, and things aren’t looking good.
But there’s good news, even now. There is still a lot of time on the clock, but we’ve got to use that time effectively. We have to stay focused in Arizona. It’s the only way we’ll hold the Senate, take back the House, and keep Trump out of the White House.

Regardless of the result, we need to make sure that we elect lawmakers that prioritize a climate safe, just, and healthy future for Oregon. With the potential rough water ahead, we need all the support we can get to ensure smooth sailing into November and beyond! [**During this month’s Sustainer Drive, OLCV’s goal is to obtain 50 new monthly donors (at any amount) who will help us fight for Oregon’s future this November.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89169994/486419096/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBkZmJkYjhhLWVlNDUtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6Zh4_2LcjNsROHIrSRR92RlPhx1jzDGGAmdOeXEy-mQ=&emci=a78830d8-8944-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0dfbdb8a-ee45-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) By joining OLCV’s Sustainer Circle, you are investing in a healthy and equitable climate future, and you will receive exclusive benefits just for sustaining donors. Monthly donors are crucial for us to make the best use of our donations this upcoming election, but there are many reasons our members commit to giving monthly. **Let’s hear directly from Donna Maebori, a member of the Sustainer Circle since 2021, about why she supports OLCV:** _Since the 1990s I had become politically active every now and then, mainly attending rallies and marches. In 2004 I learned, somehow, about canvassing for John Kerry for president and went to my first-ever campaign experience, which was followed by several more times of door knocking. The people managing it were really friendly and efficient. Over time I learned they were from OLCV. In 2016 after a certain election, I knew I wanted to be consistently active politically. Thinking back to my experience with OLCV, remembering it was good, I volunteered and have been on the Washington County Leadership Team ever since. Without a single exception, OLCV’s friendliness and efficiency is always present. OLCV is organized, effective, clear on its goals and purpose with good hearted people doing the work. Generally, the League is considered the political arm of the environmental movement. With government policy able to produce large societal changes, getting persons into office who live out environmental justice principles is absolutely vital to a viable future for the earth and all her inhabitants. Each year it becomes easier to donate, having developed deep confidence in the quality and care given to this important work by everyone involved. In fact, it is a joy to give to OLCV._ Our Sustainer Circle members are some of the biggest supporters of our work, who allow us to achieve **big wins** during the election seasons. A monthly donation to OLCV does not have to be a large amount to make a big impact on the future for Oregon. [**Will you help us smoothly sail into the November election by becoming a Sustainer Circle member today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89169995/486419097/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBkZmJkYjhhLWVlNDUtZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6Zh4_2LcjNsROHIrSRR92RlPhx1jzDGGAmdOeXEy-mQ=&emci=a78830d8-8944-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0dfbdb8a-ee45-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Sincerely,

## Biden dropping out logistics matter...
For months I have said there is no way -- no way that Biden would yield the nomination. Wednesday started to change my mind. Earlier in the week, President Biden said that he would consider stepping aside if there was a medical reason. Then, Wednesday, he was diagnosed with COVID (no mask, but that's another post). His off-ramp was clear -- whatever the latest CDC guidance is (4 days, 5 days?) is what he has to make a decision. The top brass of the Dem movement (Obama, Schiff, Jeffries, Pelosi, Schumer, Sharpton, etc) have been privately (private, yeah, right) urging him to give up.
But but but.....it's not as simple as just passing the torch. Mechnanics matter; logistics matter. First, you need a new candidate (apparently, Biden won't endorse his loyal VP), which presents a whole set of logistical issues. Next, you have to have a convention for the process to play out--and then you actually have to run a campaign (imagine that). The logistics of all of this are a BFD, to use Biden language.

| | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! Since my last update, the political landscape of our country has changed significantly. | | **✅ Tom Kean, Jr. Delivers Funding for Community Projects ✅**
---
| | This week, Tom held two ceremonies to deliver Community Project Funding checks secured during the FY24 Appropriations Process. On Monday, in Raritan Township, Tom presented a __**$459,000**__ ceremonial check to be used for the purchase and installation of new generators at the Raritan Township Municipal Building and Police Department. On Wednesday, he presented a __**$2,700,255**__ ceremonial check for the Scotch Plains Emergency Operations Center, which will relocate all emergency services to a new Emergency Operations Center. _“Scotch Plains is grateful for Congressman Kean’s support to relocate our emergency responders to a more centrally located area of town, thereby making all residents safer, while simultaneously creating opportunities in our downtown for smart growth, more open green space for community gatherings and new jobs and businesses. The prudent investments we are making today helps ensure that Scotch Plains will continue being one of the best places to live and work in New Jersey for generations to come.” _ **_ \- Joshua Losardo, Mayor of the Township of Scotch Plains _** _“I appreciate the leadership and efforts of Representative Kean to make Raritan Township a key priority. This grant is a testament to the effective collaboration between federal and local authorities in addressing the needs of our community. Congressman Kean’s support enables Raritan Township to advance our emergency management infrastructure and significantly improve our resilience to ensure that critical functions, such as our Emergency Operations Center, continue uninterrupted during emergencies. This funding will make a difference in the lives of our residents especially at the times they need it most.” _ _-**Scott Sipos, Mayor of Raritan Township**_
