clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! Since my last update, the political landscape of our country has changed significantly. On Saturday the 13th, we witnessed an awful assassination attempt on former President Trump which took the life of one rally attendee and seriously injured two others. Kean for Congress' prayers are with the former President and his family, the families of those impacted, and the country. As Tom and our team has said, This week, Tom attended many in-district events, speaking engagements, and held meetings with constituents. More on some of this below. Our Field Team, participated in volunteer trainings, door-launches, and met with local candidates to finalize field plans. The energy we are feeling on the ground has been incredible, and we were proud to welcome new volunteers into the fold this week who are ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November. To get involved, . Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | | | | | | ✅ Tom Kean, Jr. Delivers Funding for Community Projects ✅ | | This week, Tom held two ceremonies to deliver Community Project Funding checks secured during the FY24 Appropriations Process. On Monday, in Raritan Township, Tom presented a $459,000 ceremonial check to be used for the purchase and installation of new generators at the Raritan Township Municipal Building and Police Department. On Wednesday, he presented a $2,700,255 ceremonial check for the Scotch Plains Emergency Operations Center, which will relocate all emergency services to a new Emergency Operations Center. “Scotch Plains is grateful for Congressman Kean’s support to relocate our emergency responders to a more centrally located area of town, thereby making all residents safer, while simultaneously creating opportunities in our downtown for smart growth, more open green space for community gatherings and new jobs and businesses. The prudent investments we are making today helps ensure that Scotch Plains will continue being one of the best places to live and work in New Jersey for generations to come.” \- Joshua Losardo, Mayor of the Township of Scotch Plains “I appreciate the leadership and efforts of Representative Kean to make Raritan Township a key priority. This grant is a testament to the effective collaboration between federal and local authorities in addressing the needs of our community. Congressman Kean’s support enables Raritan Township to advance our emergency management infrastructure and significantly improve our resilience to ensure that critical functions, such as our Emergency Operations Center, continue uninterrupted during emergencies. This funding will make a difference in the lives of our residents especially at the times they need it most.” -Scott Sipos, Mayor of Raritan Township | | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | This week, our Field Team was busy with volunteer trainings, door-launches, phone banks, and meeting with local candidates! One highlight of the week was when the Somerset County Republican Organization held a vote-by-mail (VBM) training at our Battlestation. At this seminar, leaders like Chairwoman DiFrancesco and Warren Township Committeeman Dan Croson explained the importance of VBM to volunteers in the field, and laid the groundwork for a comprehensive VBM push that Kean for Congress will assist on. As a VBM voter myself, I know how important it is to "play ball" on VBM efforts and cut into Democrats' lead before Election Day. Many thanks to the Chairwoman and Dan for their work on this front. Our door knocking program continued this week in Bedminster , Bernardsville , Springfield , Westfield, Somerville , and Hackettstown! We also are hosting launches in coordination with our county and municipal organizations this weekend in Long Hill and Mendham Borough. We hope to see you there. Kean for Congress held our weekly phone bank series in Morris county on Wednesday evening. There, we engaged in positive conversations with the critical swing-voter universe, a key to our winning coalition. I would like to give a shoutout to one of our fantastic interns, Jerry , who set a new record for weekly calls this cycle by making over 1,000 alone. These efforts are excellent and we are lucky to have many volunteers like Jerry who are contributing to our efforts. We have a few more phone banks lined up in the coming weeks that you can join! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | 🚨 ENDORSEMENT UPDATE 🚨 | | | | After securing the endorsement of the New Jersey Building and Construction Trades Council , and the Operating Engineers 825 last week, Tom attended and spoke at the Building Trades 119th Convention in Atlantic City on Tuesday. There, he spoke about the positive impact labor has on innovation and infrastructure in New Jersey, and met with labor leaders from across the state. Follow our using this link for more endorsements to be announced in the coming days! | | | | | 🎥 More Local Leaders Endorse Tom Kean, Jr. 🎥 Click to watch! | | | | | | | | Volunteer of the Week:Pat Cassio | | | | Pat Cassio of Rahway is a member of the Rahway Knights of Columbus, a small business owner, and a volunteer in the Rahway community at large. He has been a Rahway native since his birth. Patrick trained in an apprenticeship and developed his carpenter career. An active Republican, Pat has been a stalwart of the Union County and Rahway organizations most of his life. He recently helped lead the charge to recruit six ward candidates in Rahway, and guide their primary write-in campaigns. This week, he organized a Rahway training for candidates and volunteers with Team Kean. Please thank Pat for all his hard work - we are lucky to have him on the Kean for Congress team. | | | | | Tom In The News | | - | | | | | RESERVE A TOM KEAN LAWN SIGN | | | | | | | | | Get Involved : Join our team and help spread our message in the community. : Your contributions power our grassroots efforts and make a difference. mailto:JJ@TomKean.com "JJ@TomKean.com": The Kean for Congress Team is looking for dedicated and responsible high school and college age Republicans that are interested in a campaign internship. When I was 14 years old, my mother, my sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador in the hope of achieving our American Dream. As I adjusted to life and high school in a new country, my mom worked double shifts to support our family. But even still, it was a struggle to pay the bills and afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**
I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, **_bought_** two doughnut shops.

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. ****For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his private corporate career.**
I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

If you ask me, our differing stories in the doughnut business make the differences between us pretty clear.
**I know we can win — and new polling data shows our campaign 4 points ahead! But Rick Scott spent $64 million to buy this seat in 2018 and has already written _six-figure_ personal checks to his campaign this time around.** **[I can't win this race without your help. Hey, Peter! The Olympics kick off a week from today in Paris, and I couldn’t be more excited. Some folks know I did track & field in high school and held my school’s record in the triple jump for a long time. I knew where Eugene was, even as a high schooler in Pennsylvania, because of Track Town’s reputation. And, yes, I had Nike spikes. I loved following the Track and Field Olympic Trials right here in Oregon last month and am looking forward to cheering on all our athletes – _particularly the Oregonians and those connected to Oregon schools_. Oregon State’s **Jade Carey** will be competing alongside Simone Biles and Suni Lee on the women’s gymnastics team in her second straight Olympics! University of Oregon’s **Cole Hocker** broke the Olympic Trials record for the Men’s 1500m by a whole 3.5 seconds! Oregon native and shot put record-holder **Ryan Crouser** will be trying to defend his title and win his third straight gold medal. He would become the first man to win three Olympic gold medals in shot put! Friends,
I know that so many people are feeling scared right now, worried about the fate of our democracy and the trajectory of our country. And I get it. It feels like every time we turn on the TV or check our social media, there’s more division and more uncertainty – especially when it comes to the upcoming election.

body:
https://jenaforcolorado.com/ [https://jenaforcolorado.com/]
Friends –
The first women’s rights convention occurred in Seneca Falls, New York, on July 19, 1848. A group of visionary women and men, led by Elizabeth Cady Stanton and Lucretia Mott, gathered to demand equal rights for women, including the right to vote, own property, receive education, and participate fully in society.
Their groundbreaking Declaration of Sentiments boldly declared, "We hold these truths to be self-evident: that all men and women are created equal." This powerful statement, inspired by the Declaration of Independence, marked the beginning of a movement that would transform our nation.
Over seven decades after the Seneca Falls Convention, the women’s suffrage movement that began there led to granting women the right to vote via the 19th Amendment. As Secretary of State, I am proud to stand on the shoulders of the earliest suffragists and continue the fight for women in Colorado and across our country. Whether it be by increasing access to the polls or by working to keep Colorado a safe haven for abortion and reproductive healthcare, I will always do my part in protecting and expanding women’s rights.
As we honor this anniversary, we must recognize the progress we have made and acknowledge the work that still lies ahead. Let us recognize this important anniversary in our nation’s history and recommit ourselves to the fight for equality.

| | | **Celebrate the Spirit of Apollo 11 – Support Our Campaign****!**
---

Dear Peter,
History was made on July 20, 1969, when the Boeing-built Saturn V booster launched Apollo 11 and headed towards humanity’s first moon landing. This monumental achievement, with key contributions from the dedicated team in Kent, Washington, united our nation and showcased American ingenuity, determination, and courage. This incredible mission not only placed the first humans on the moon but also inspired generations to reach for the stars and achieve the impossible.
As we honor this legacy, our campaign in Washington’s 8th Congressional District is committed to fostering the same spirit of innovation and progress. We believe in the power of American exceptionalism and are dedicated to policies that encourage technological advancement, strengthen our economy, and uphold the values that made the Apollo 11 mission possible.

---
| | | |
---
|
Your support is crucial in helping us continue this mission. Your contribution will enable us to reach more voters, share our vision, and advocate for the principles that drive our community forward.
Whether it’s $20, $50, or any amount, your donation will make a significant impact..

| | _**Hoosiers On the National Stage**_
---
| | Friends, The Indiana delegation represented all Hoosiers this week on the national stage in Milwaukee for the Republican National Convention. 113 delegates and alternate delegates represented by some of the best Republican leaders Indiana has to offer joined the RNC and officially nominated President Donald J. Trump and his running-mate Senator J.D. Vance. Cementing our top-to-bottom winning Republican ticket in November! A major congratulations and thank you from the entire Indiana delegation goes to Indiana's very own RNC Chair for the Committee on Arrangement and our Indiana National Committeewoman, Anne Hathaway. With her team and leadership delegates from around the nation participated in one of the most historic conventions in our nation's history. We also want to thank the Chairman of the Indiana Delegation, Senator Braun, for leading our delegates this week! And congrats to Representative Jim Banks for his primetime speaking role at the convention. These Hoosiers showed true leadership throughout the week as our Indiana delegation showed the world that our home state is ready to elect the Trump-Vance ticket in November!
---

**_The Trump-Vance Ticket!_**
---
---
This was a huge week for the Republican Party. Not only did we all come together as Republicans and unify behind the top of our ticket, but Hoosiers showcased our great state's enthusiasm for our party! Our own Indiana Republican National Committeewoman and Chairwoman of the RNC's Committee on Arrangements, Anne Hathaway, put on an excellent event that has garnered national praise. Sen. Mike Braun led the Indiana delegation as our chairman, Rep. Jim Banks had a primetime speaking spot, and our Indiana National Committeeman Victor Smith had the honor of adjourning the session Tuesday night. Not to mention all the members of the Indiana delegation showing up each night full of energy! Hoosiers showed up and showed out; we couldn't be more proud!

We finally have our official ticket for November. Donald Trump made a strong decision choosing J.D. Vance to be his running mate, a man who represents the everyday working Americans of our country. A man who is ready to fight for America and the people and communities that call it home.

Who is J.D. Vance?
---
* Senator Vance has a rich life story, a strong dedication to his family, and a deep love of country. He brings valuable experience and wisdom gained through his life journey.
* Vance grew up in poverty in Appalachia and came from a broken home, with a mother who struggled with substance abuse. Raised by his grandmother, he later served in the Marines and earned degrees from Ohio State University and Yale Law School.
* Like President Trump, Senator Vance is committed to defending the working class who built this nation. For him, America First is a guiding principle.
* Senator Vance would be the first Marine veteran and the first millennial to serve as Vice President in American history.
* With this pick, President Trump ensures that his effort to Make America Great Again will continue, aiming for a sweeping victory over the radical left this November.

---
We know the Democrats are already trying to divide our party with comments from almost a decade ago! Here is what to remember if you are asked about Sen. Vance's past comments:
---
* 10 years ago, Senator Vance didn’t know President Trump, but he witnessed President Trump’s record, results, and success during his historic first term and realized he and President Trump had the same vision for saving our country.
* If President Trump can change Senator Vance’s mind, President Trump can change the minds of millions of Americans, and Senator Vance will be able to reach undecided voters on a personal level.
* In contrast, the Democrat ticket is a complete disaster. Kamala Harris said that Joe Biden was a racist, criticized Biden for palling around with a former Grand Wizard from the KKK, and famously reminded Biden on the debate stage that she was that little girl Biden didn’t want living in his community.

---
And as always, remember that the Indiana Democrats are just as extreme as the Biden/Harris ticket. There is no place for the radical, liberal agenda that the Democrats are trying to push. Republicans stand united behind the Trump/Vance ticket!
---

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Destiny Wells and Terry Goodin Round Out Our Ticket At Successful State Convention On Saturday, July 13, nearly 2,000 delegates flocked to the Indiana Convention Center for the 2024 Indiana State Democratic Convention. Democrats were riled up and ready to return balance to Hoosier politics by nominating Terry Goodin for lieutenant governor and Destiny Wells for attorney general, which completed the Indiana Democratic ticket. Under the administrations of these dedicated candidates, Indiana is set to return to the national stage as a state known for its pragmatic, compassionate politics, but to get there we need your help. Make sure you double check your voter status and . Hoosiers, we’ll see you on or before November 5th at the polls. Hoosiers Know Why Pence Isn’t Trump’s VP Pick Again J.D. Vance is willing to transform the presidency into a dictatorship through the implementation of Project 2025, making him a threat to democracy and the American way of life. There’s voting along party lines, and then there’s voting to protect our nation’s integrity. Hoosiers know why Mike Pence is no longer on the Trump ticket: he stood up for democracy. Meanwhile, the Biden-Harris administration is dedicated to ensuring that the office of the president is representative of what the people want — not some political agenda. That’s why we have to show up big this November to make sure Trump and Vance are stopped before they have a chance to start turning the tide. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week, US Rep. Frank Mrvan (D-1) announced Community Project Funding Requests for the upcoming fiscal year. In addition to various police departments, funding will go towards improvements in Michigan City, Purdue University Northwest, the town of Cedar Lake, and the Northern Indiana Commuter Transportation District. “I am grateful for the inclusion of these federal funding requests for transformational projects to create work and wealth throughout Indiana’s First Congressional District. Thank you to all of the Northwest Indiana stakeholders for your diligence to identify these worthy initiatives that will support economic development, create good-paying job opportunities, and increase public safety in our region,” In total, a little over $10 million in requests were filed. # _Conservative groups lining up behind Kahrs campaign_
Dear Friends,
I wanted to make sure you saw the news. In recent days, Kansans for Life PAC, the Kansas State Rifle Association PAC, and the Family Research Council Action PAC have announced they are endorsing my campaign.
Kansans for Life fights for the unborn in Kansas.
---
| The Kansas State Rifle Association is the voice of Kansas gun owners and fights our Second Amendment rights.
---
|

The FRC Action PAC advocates for family-centered values and religious liberties from a biblical worldview.
These endorsements again send a clear message to voters that I am the trusted conservative in this race.
Here’s what FRC Action PAC said in its endorsement letter: “Your experience will allow you to make an impact in Congress on day one. Your commitment to our shared values means you will speak up on behalf of the unborn, strong families, and religious freedoms. You are the type of leader our country desperately needs.”
Here’s what KSRA said: “Jeff Kahrs has consistently stood for Second Amendment freedoms throughout his time working for elected officials and has actively supported the KSRA.”
As a member of Congress, I will never stop defending our constitutional right to own guns, protecting life and religious liberty, and advocating for strong families.
For liberty,

name: Janelle Bynum
subject: As a mom of four
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JANELLE BYNUM FOR CONGRESS
body:
Do you want to know what keeps me up at night, friend? Thinking about the world we’re passing along to our children.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89181573/486459423/476240536?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.07.19_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNmODAwNTEtMDU0Ni1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dKgWwndW4ZyrvaRGisCtM65Y64tuJ-YBkV8CQvmXfbc=) Do you want to know what keeps me up at night, friend? Thinking about the world we’re passing along to our children. My grandparents and my parents worked hard and passed along opportunities to me. Their sacrifices and courage are the reason why I was able to go to college, become an engineer, and serve my community. They are the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream. And now, I'm teaching my kids to live the same way – to dream big and always stand up for themselves. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89181574/486459426/476240536?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2024.07.19_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzNmODAwNTEtMDU0Ni1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dKgWwndW4ZyrvaRGisCtM65Y64tuJ-YBkV8CQvmXfbc=) **But these days, the American Dream is out of reach for more and more families.** Too many Oregonians are priced out of their communities or unable to afford a home. And our fundamental rights – to vote, to access reproductive health care, and so much more – are increasingly under attack. name: Sarah McBride
subject: Help me stand up to MTG, Matt Gaetz, and anti-trans extremists in Congress
body:
Their rhetoric has real world consequences for real people.
#
Transphobia was on _full_ display at the Republican National Convention.
Over the past week, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Matt Gaetz, and other MAGA extremists launched incendiary attacks on trans people during prime-time television.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240719-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240719-1-835&refcode2=835_21716_d1f0CS&akid=835%2E21716%2Ed1f0CS)
These are the _same_ cruel attacks and rhetoric these extreme politicians hurl in the halls of Congress — and right now, there’s no transgender person in the U.S. House to stand up to them.
[**This campaign can change that. You can change that. Can you pitch in $5 to my campaign today to help us finally elect an out trans person to Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240719-1?refcode=em20240719-1-835&amount=5&refcode2=835_21716_d1f0CS&akid=835%2E21716%2Ed1f0CS)
**The extreme right-wing is desperate, and doubling down on their hate and division is their only hope.** They’re continuing to use the trans community as a scapegoat for their policy failures — and **their rhetoric has _real_ world consequences for _real_ people.**
In Congress and in states across the country, we’re continuing to face more and more cruel attempts to discriminate against LGBTQ+ people, especially trans people. And if Donald Trump and JD Vance win, we know the far-right will be even more emboldened.
**While the far-right bullies trans kids and attacks our rights, we need a trans person in Congress to fight back and advocate for an agenda that supports ALL of us** — from paid family and medical leave and abortion rights to affordable health care and housing and worker protections.
[**Help me take trans visibility to the next level...precisely when we need it most. Pitch in to support my campaign today — I can’t do it without folks like you in Pennsylvania.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240719-1?refcode=em20240719-1-835&amount=5&refcode2=835_21716_d1f0CS&akid=835%2E21716%2Ed1f0CS)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240719-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240719-1-835&refcode2=835_21716_d1f0CS&akid=835%2E21716%2Ed1f0CS)**
Thank you for all you do for equality,
Sarah McBride

[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e787fa20-dd70-4a8a-9bc8-72b3b1d6d47b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

While we will delve into that exceptional message another time, there is a pressing issue for Connecticut voters - **YOUR ENERGY BILLS.**
There was a time when the Bill had 2 lines - Supply Costs to make the energy and Transmission Costs to deliver it. I just got my bill and today there are 9 lines and the costs are skyrocketing. **You have to be an accountant to understand the bill:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1f4fe0c4-4523-44f8-bfb5-9744e50f2b46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Source - Connecticut Office of Consumer Counsel](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c363ec3c-893e-48b9-842f-d99a8465e8d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
WHAT DOES THIS ALL MEAN? - There are 4 parts to this Never-ending bill: **Supply, Transmission, Local Delivery, and Public Benefits**.
* **Supply** \- this is the cost of energy generation - this is what it costs to make your power. In Connecticut, we rely on Nuclear and Natural Gas and our Energy Supply Costs are some of the highest in the Nation. If elected to Congress, I would fight to reduce regulation for mini nuclear power (**Our Cheapest and Greenest Energy**) and repeal the Jones Act for US Natural Gas - The windmills will not save Connecticut - [See a prior article on that.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cabcfee6-3eeb-4c8d-8da8-0487c4cea497?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**For this line item, according to Connecticut - Eversource and UI do not make a profit on this one.**_** **
* **Transmission -** This is regulated by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC). **If elected as your next Congressman, this is a federal issue where I could help to try to ease the pain**. For Transmission, Eversource and UI get a return on their investment to transmit the power to you.
* The **Local Delivery** \- This is your CT Government and the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) at work. Eversource and UI earn a return on their distribution investments which is authorized and regulated by PURA.
* The **Public Benefits** part of your bill is the kicker and is what you are charged for Eversource and UI to provide some things like grid reliability, affordability, clean energy and other mandates from Hartford. These are directly the result of bad energy policy due to a democrat controlled House and Senate.

**The last bucket does not benefit you but it might benefit your neighbor or others**. It is about 7 percent of your bill.
You may be asking Yourself - **WHAT IS THE PUBLIC BENEFIT AND AM I PART OF THE PUBLIC?**
These are effective taxes for you the hardworking Nutmegger to subsidize the utility companies and others who cannot afford to pay their bills and others who "go green" because they are told of the benefits. When they go green they are always sold the dream that equipment pays for itself. Well it pays for itself because you are paying and they are not. **The best part is you have no say in these takings and they are effectively government programs paid for with your after tax dollars.**
The System Benefits Charge is a subsidy where you are paying part of your electric bill to help people who cannot pay the bill (**which is a normal government assistance program that is administered by the government**). Connecticut has multiple programs that help those who cannot pay their bills and this is affecting a lot of every day Nutmeggers. A link to all these programs is listed in the most recent [Consumer Alert ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4b5eb21f-41b1-4d9a-8d89-84032ba4d47d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from the CT OCC. While we have compassion for those who cannot pay their bills due to hardship, **this should be a function of the State and Federal Government**.
This sudden burden of forced charity could also be a result of an influx of illegals into Connecticut. You may be paying this because our Constitutional State is overwhelmed and outsourced this to you the tax payer to deal with. Or rather, they are imposing a taxation without representation.
**YES - Our Border Crisis is hitting CT and we are as much a border town as any other State. We must close the border and reverse the Biden/Himes curse.**
Another whammy to your bill is the Renewal Investment Charge. Essentially you, the taxpayer and now the billpayer, are making an investment that is run by CT to subsidize those who install renewable energy like solar panels. This is administered by the Connecticut Green Bank. They get panels and you pay.
The next shock to your wallet is the Conversion Adjustment Mechanism (CAM) charge. This is another conversion subsidy for your neighbors and an annual wealth transfer for about $160 million.
The final rate jolt in this "benefits" section is the Non-Bypassable Federally Mandated Conversion Charge (NBFMCC). This electric alphabet soup has initial renewable energy incentives at about 4.362 cents per KwH for Eversource and 2.7359 cents per KwH for UI.
Last I checked, you never thought you were going to be forced to help pay others bills or invest in a program where you do not see the benefit of it. Well you do and its called your taxes but this utility bill is not you W-2 or W-9 paycheck stub.
**While I object to this taking by the government, you should at least get a tax credit on your state and federal income tax.**_**While I work with your local state reps and senators to fight Hartford, I will be proposing that legislation in Congress to make the burden less shocking to your wallet.**_
The only way through this is sound energy policy for the US with the restoration of American Energy Independence, Micro-nuclear reactors to replace the nuclear dinosaurs in Connecticut and opening up new gas pipelines to Connecticut. **Your Utility Bill should not be the never-ending line item.**
**Demand Transparency and Accountability and this is why I am running for Congress.**
**This is why it is more important to make your voices heard at the ballot box this November and this August at the Primary. There are no excuses.** This is your fight to save your wallet, our democracy and our country and **the time is NOW**.
**IF YOU JUST GOT YOUR BILL - MAKE A NOTE TO GO AND VOTE ON AUGUST 13th. You have a pocketbook to save.**
Help me get through this primary so we can get to the people and retire Jim.
**MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.**
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.
Dr. Michael Goldstein

The Public Benefits part of your bill is the kicker and is what you are charged for Eversource and UI to provide some things like grid reliability, affordability, clean energy and other mandates from Hartford. These are directly the result of bad energy policy due to a democrat controlled House and Senate. The last bucket does not benefit you but it might benefit your neighbor or others. It is about 7 percent of your bill. You may be asking Yourself - WHAT IS THE PUBLIC BENEFIT AND AM I PART OF THE PUBLIC? These are effective taxes for you the hardworking Nutmegger to subsidize the utility companies and others who cannot afford to pay their bills and others who "go green" because they are told of the benefits. When they go green they are always sold the dream that equipment pays for itself. Well it pays for itself because you are paying and they are not. The best part is you have no say in these takings and they are effectively government programs paid for with your after tax dollars. The System Benefits Charge is a subsidy where you are paying part of your electric bill to help people who cannot pay the bill (which is a normal government assistance program that is administered by the government). Connecticut has multiple programs that help those who cannot pay their bills and this is affecting a lot of every day Nutmeggers. A link to all these programs is listed in the most recent the CT OCC. While we have compassion for those who cannot pay their bills due to hardship, this should be a function of the State and Federal Government. This sudden burden of forced charity could also be a result of an influx of illegals into Connecticut. You may be paying this because our Constitutional State is overwhelmed and outsourced this to you the tax payer to deal with. Or rather, they are imposing a taxation without representation. YES - Our Border Crisis is hitting CT and we are as much a border town as any other State. We must close the border and reverse the Biden/Himes curse. Another whammy to your bill is the Renewal Investment Charge. Essentially you, the taxpayer and now the billpayer, are making an investment that is run by CT to subsidize those who install renewable energy like solar panels. This is administered by the Connecticut Green Bank. They get panels and you pay. The next shock to your wallet is the Conversion Adjustment Mechanism (CAM) charge. This is another conversion subsidy for your neighbors and an annual wealth transfer for about $160 million. The final rate jolt in this "benefits" section is the Non-Bypassable Federally Mandated Conversion Charge (NBFMCC). This electric alphabet soup has initial renewable energy incentives at about 4.362 cents per KwH for Eversource and 2.7359 cents per KwH for UI. Last I checked, you never thought you were going to be forced to help pay others bills or invest in a program where you do not see the benefit of it. Well you do and its called your taxes but this utility bill is not you W-2 or W-9 paycheck stub. While I object to this taking by the government, you should at least get a tax credit on your state and federal income tax.While I work with your local state reps and senators to fight Hartford, I will be proposing that legislation in Congress to make the burden less shocking to your wallet. The only way through this is sound energy policy for the US with the restoration of American Energy Independence, Micro-nuclear reactors to replace the nuclear dinosaurs in Connecticut and opening up new gas pipelines to Connecticut. Your Utility Bill should not be the never-ending line item. Demand Transparency and Accountability and this is why I am running for Congress. This is why it is more important to make your voices heard at the ballot box this November and this August at the Primary. There are no excuses. This is your fight to save your wallet, our democracy and our country and the time is NOW. IF YOU JUST GOT YOUR BILL - MAKE A NOTE TO GO AND VOTE ON AUGUST 13th. You have a pocketbook to save. Help me get through this primary so we can get to the people and retire Jim. MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.** Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on. Thank you for your continued support. clean_body: When Lauren Boebert suddenly announced that she was packing up her bags and leaving Western Colorado, we were all shocked. But maybe we shouldn’t have been. Hello, When Lauren Boebert suddenly announced that she was packing up her bags and leaving Western Colorado, we were all shocked. But maybe we shouldn’t have been. My husband Adam Frisch ran against Boebert in 2022 and came just 546 votes short of defeating her. Our family, campaign team, and all of our volunteers had worked hard – very hard. Adam drove over 24,000 miles with our son Felix meeting with voters across the entire district. But ultimately, we were out-spent and came up short. This past year, we decided to give it another go, and we’ve been working even harder than the last campaign. With support from grassroots donors like you, we were out-raising Boebert – and Adam had already driven another 24,000 miles to listen to voters. It looked like we were heading for a win... so Lauren Boebert ran off scared. But with Boebert now out of the race, things are going to be harder. We’ve got a new Republican opponent who is trying to hide his extremism, and the Republican Super PACs are already circling to try to stop us from winning. This is a must-win House seat this November. Ours was the closest race in the entire country in 2022. In 2008, my Humvee was hit by a bomb in Afghanistan. I was covered in diesel fuel and burned alive. I was saved by the words of my gunner, who said **_“Sir, I’ve got you!”_**

They gave me hope, the kind of hope needed to make it through years of surgeries that left my face permanently scarred. In hindsight, that day was a blessing in more ways than you could imagine. Though my body and face were permanently scarred, my soul was saved that day. As President Trump now knows all too well, coming so close to death has a way of changing a person’s life and renewing one’s faith in God. I was willing to lay down my life for my country, and to this day I still am. I was proud to serve in Afghanistan and I will be proud to serve again alongside President Trump.

**_America, I’ve got you!_** Friend, I’m in the middle of a tough election. I won’t lie, this isn’t easy. * We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

subject: Please join me, Rob McKenna, David Condon and Jack Thompson

body:
Fundraisers coming up in Spokane and Walla Walla. | | | | | |
---
| **The Garden Party, with Rob McKenna, David Condon and more**
---
| You’re invited to join us for a fundraiser in Spokane next Wednesday, July 24 \- with special guests former State Attorney General Rob McKenna, former Spokane Mayor David Condon, Tanya Low, Jack Thompson and Sen. Lynda Wilson.
Click on the invite below, or [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=2cf08626e1&e=5a45b9550e) to RSVP.
Hope you can join us!
---
[](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=5e2f4e1960&e=5a45b9550e)
|
---
| **Reception in Walla Walla**
---
| For those in the Walla Walla area, we would love to see you at our fundraising reception coming up on Monday, July 29 \- graciously hosted by the Honorable Mike and Cory Hewitt, Paul and Gail Mackay, Ben and Sharon Sinner and Justin Wylie.
Details are below, and you can also RSVP [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=2174edfd29&e=5a45b9550e).
---
[](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=36df041b1a&e=5a45b9550e)
|
---
| **Fun at parades in Cheney and Oakesdale!**
---
| Last weekend we had a great team of supporters out for the Cheney Rodeo parade - and also down in Oakesdale for the Old Mill Days celebration.
Thank you to everyone who joined us to help reach voters! You are very much appreciated.
---
| **Meeting with veterans & first responders **
---
| Earlier this week I appreciated meeting with veterans and first responders in Deer Park. I was especially honored to receive a “Flag Star” from the local vet support group.
Later in the day I attended a meeting in Northport about the Upper Columbia River. The future of the Columbia River - and the dams that provide energy and agricultural transportation - are very important issues for our 5th District.
---
| **Thank you to our letter-writers**
---
| We appreciate these supporters taking the time to share their thoughts with local newspapers.
**Lewiston Tribune: Vote for Baumgartner** Bill Mulligan, Clarkston: _“...Michael has committed to securing our borders, supporting law enforcement, improving management of public lands to check wildfires, and refocusing our military on defending our country. He has worked overseas where he developed an understanding and respect for many other cultures. He was with the Department of State in Iraq helping coordinate military operations. Michael is a dedicated family man, good listener, problem solver, and his resume is extensive and impressive.”_[Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=7216f2331f&e=5a45b9550e)
**Spokesman: Vote Baumgartner to fix the fentanyl problem** Patricia Kienholz, Spokane:_“..I’m supporting Michael Baumgartner for Congress because I know he understands the problem and will bring leadership to this huge challenge that we are facing. I heard him speak recently about the issue and he has taken the time to listen to our local law enforcement and our business community. He has traveled south to visit the border in Arizona and spoke in depth with many key stakeholders about how we can fix this situation.”_[Read here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=b7541a50b7&e=5a45b9550e)
If you are interested in writing a letter to help our campaign and would like to know how to get it submitted, please contact eleanor@votebaumgartner.com.
---
|
---
| **Yard signs and upcoming events**
---
| Ballots were mailed out to voters this week!
**Signs:** If you’re able to show your support with a yard sign, please fill out the “Get Involved” form at https://www.votebaumgartner.com/get-involved - or email campaign manager Erich at erich@votebaumgartner.com.
**Parade:** Please also contact Erich if you can join our family for the parade at Davenport Pioneer Days this Saturday, July 20th at 10:30am, or if you would like to come knock on doors on Sunday afternoon.
**Sign-waving:** We start morning/evening sign-waves next week in Spokane. Please contact Erich for details if you can spare an hour!
Thank you very much for your wonderful support in these final weeks before the Primary!
-Mike
---
|
---
[DONATE TODAY!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=cc0f5ff561&e=5a45b9550e)
|
---
| Paid for by Vote Baumgartner for Congress | (509) 370-8398 | www.votebaumgartner.com

Our mailing address is: Vote Baumgartner for Congress, PO Box 8508, Spokane, WA 99203

---
|

We want you to think -- just for a moment -- about how you felt when this was on your television screen the first time Donald Trump ran for president: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-elect-dems-2024?amount=7&refcode=em_20240719_448_fr&refcode2=499_22930333_sJ1qjb&akid=499%2E22930333%2EsJ1qjb) And how you felt, shortly after, when Republicans won the House and Senate: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-elect-dems-2024?amount=7&refcode=em_20240719_448_fr&refcode2=499_22930333_sJ1qjb&akid=499%2E22930333%2EsJ1qjb) Remember the disbelief we all felt and the fear of what was to come ahead? name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: Climate change is worsening
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We need your support to protect the Earth.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240719&t=1&akid=962%2E587540%2EaJeiex)
**Peter, it’s getting hotter — and we have to do something about it.**
Earlier this year, it was reported that 2023 was the hottest year since global records began in 1850. And it doesn’t stop there. 2024 is expected to rival 2023, and could potentially take its place as the hottest year on record.
Our elected leaders are failing to address the climate crisis with meaningful solutions, so it’s time we put people who care in office.
Leaders We Deserve endorses young leaders who understand the anxiety of not knowing if the planet will be inhabitable for our kids and will live to see it. We also endorse candidates who **DO NOT** take any corporate money, _including fossil fuel companies._
**[Will you join the hundreds of folks who have already signed our petition demanding that our elected leaders enact meaningful solutions to the climate crisis? We’re building a movement they can’t ignore!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/20240719-climate-change-pt-email/?source=em20240719&akid=962%2E587540%2EaJeiex)**
**[Sign the Petition](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/20240719-climate-change-pt-email/&?source=em20240719-962&akid=962%2E587540%2EaJeiex)**
**We’re nearing a point of no return, Peter.** If we don’t take immediate and decisive action, the devastating impacts of climate change will become irreversible.
This June marked 12 consecutive months of the global temperature being at or above 1.5C, the benchmark for avoiding the worst effects of climate change. We have a real issue on our hands.
That’s why Leaders We Deserve is endorsing young leaders like climate activist Nate Douglas, who’s running in one of the most competitive state house races in Florida, and so many others passionate about finding meaningful solutions to the climate crisis. We’re not just talking about climate change — we’re working to make meaningful change happen.
**[Peter, our politicians have gotten too comfortable ignoring the climate crisis — and we’re putting an end to it. Sign our petition to support actual solutions to the climate crisis before it is too late!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/sign/20240719-climate-change-pt-email/?source=em20240719&akid=962%2E587540%2EaJeiex)**

Thank you for your support,

| **ICYMI: RPVI at the RNC**
Over the past two weeks delegates from the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands have been in Milwaukee, WI working hard to ensure proper representation for our beautiful territory on the national stage.
At the convention, delegates to the RNC adopted a party platform that vows to protect our often forgotten territories:
_Republicans Will Protect Americans in the Territories._
_The territories of Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Puerto Rico are of vital importance to our National Security, and we welcome their greater participation in all aspects of the political process._
---

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/232fa3fcd49a/molinaro-meets-with-schoharie-locals-on-inflation-law-enforcement-9433204?e=a39a20e5dd)
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Less than a week ago, we witnessed an attempt on former President Donald Trump's life. I am [pushing to address](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=9adcf65b30&e=a39a20e5dd) this massive security breach, to understand how it could have occurred, and what measures we need to implement to prevent such threats in the future.

It also serves as a time for reflection. To tone down the political rhetoric and come together as one nation. We don't agree on everything, and we don't have to. But we do need to be able to talk, connect, and try to understand one another.

>From the beginning I have been committed to working across the aisle and representing everyone from my district, regardless of party. You have my word that will continue.
---
|
---
|
---
Middle-income families across the United States are facing significant financial pressures as living costs continue to rise faster than incomes.

I am deeply concerned about the impact this has on our wallets and our well-being, and it underscores the urgent need for policies that support economic stability and affordability for all Americans.

That's why I introduced the Lower Grocery Prices Act, that aims to rein in the price of groceries and address the cost of living crisis. And I will continue to advocate for solutions that ensure families can thrive, not just survive.

\- [Molinaro Introduces the bipartisan ](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=7976a7ba51&e=a39a20e5dd)[Lower Grocery Prices Act](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=ec6b6c6f6a&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
In our ongoing efforts to enhance public safety and accountability, I have introduced a bill aimed at creating a registry for migrants convicted of felonies.

This proposed legislation is designed to ensure that law enforcement agencies have access to critical information, helping to protect our communities and uphold the rule of law. By implementing this registry, we can better track individuals who have committed serious crimes and ensure they are held accountable.

This initiative is a crucial step in maintaining the safety and security of our neighborhoods, and I am committed to working tirelessly to see it through. [- Molinaro introduces bill to create registry for migrants convicted of felonies](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=34cc1e6cfe&e=a39a20e5dd)
| [_Wondering how you can help win reelection?
Chip in $5, $10, or $15 to my campaign today. **Every dollar matters.**_](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=9c719653f8&e=a39a20e5dd)
---
|
---
|
---
As your representative in Congress, I am committed to ensuring that our seniors receive the healthcare they deserve.

I am proud to support recent legislation aimed at defending Medicare Advantage plans, which are vital for many Upstate New Yorkers. These plans provide comprehensive care and essential benefits tailored to the needs of our senior citizens.

By safeguarding Medicare Advantage, we are upholding our promise to protect the health and well-being of our aging population, ensuring they have access to the quality healthcare they need to live with dignity and peace of mind.

[- ](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=d6a3e6037b&e=a39a20e5dd)[Upstate NY health plans support legislation to defend Medicare Advantage Plans for seniors](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=9207681ebd&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
I am pleased to share that we have successfully secured funding for a crucial upgrade to the Town of Chenango’s waste management system.

This project, which represents a significant investment in our community’s infrastructure, will modernize our facilities, enhance operational efficiency, and promote environmental sustainability. These improvements are essential for maintaining the health and well-being of our residents and ensuring that Chenango continues to be a great place to live and work.

Thank you to everyone who has contributed to making this initiative possible. Together, we are building a brighter, cleaner future for our community.

[\- Funding secured for Town of Chenango waste management upgrade](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=32093dd510&e=a39a20e5dd)

body:
Help us get the school year started off right for kids in our community.
#
Last year, we gave out 1,115 backpacks to kids in our community who didn’t have one as they headed back to school. **This year, we want to double that number.**
[Will you chip in $8 today to help us send 2,000 students to school with a new backpack and school supplies this year?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240719-backpacks.SSxr8Z&refcode=em20240719-6835-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6835%2E2526796%2EXtDrM7)
**[Contribute🎒✏️📗](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240719-backpacks.SSxr8Z&refcode=em20240719-6835-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6835%2E2526796%2EXtDrM7)**
****
This is Alexandria’s sixth back-to-school drive, and in that time we’ve teamed up with NYC public housing developments, community organizations, houses of worship, food pantries and local elected officials to **give thousands of kids a strong start to the school year with pencils, pens, crayons, erasers, notebooks, rulers, and a backpack.**
Many of the organizations we partner with to distribute school supplies — such as Make The Road NY, the Street Vendors Project, and NICE — focus on uplifting our most vulnerable communities, including immigrants new to the U.S.
We’ve run the numbers, and $8 — $10 means a child without school supplies can start the year with their head held high.
[Can you chip in today to help us make that happen?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240719-backpacks.SSxr8Z&refcode=em20240719-6835-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6835%2E2526796%2EXtDrM7)
**[Help us start the school year off right →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240719-backpacks.SSxr8Z&refcode=em20240719-6835-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6835%2E2526796%2EXtDrM7)**
With deepest thanks,
Team AOC

The RNC has wrapped up, folks, and what a week it’s been.
Despite promises to focus on unity and healing in the wake of the reprehensible (and thankfully failed) attempt on his life, Donald Trump went right back to his lies and threats in his marathon acceptance speech last night.
If it wasn’t already clear, this week sealed the deal – these men are dangerous and they have to go.

# The Left’s War on Our Youth
---
| |
---
|
---
|
Our nation is under siege. As our friend Dr. Jeff Myers [recently noted](https://saveamernow.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bfee6d8faa8bd945842640631&id=2b9a14cccd&e=c50c08d277), radical leftists are brainwashing Gen Z young adults — pushing them towards violence and chaos. A recent assassination attempt on President Trump and the alarming response from our youth, with the hashtag #theymissed trending, shows the depth of this crisis.

Liberal indoctrination is rampant. A Harvard poll shockingly reveals that 60% of Gen Z believes Hamas’s attacks on Israelis are justified. This is the direct result of Biden’s dangerous rhetoric, labeling Trump as a threat to America.

The radicalization of our youth is a deliberate, three-step process: isolation through fear, recruitment by exploiting loneliness, and activation into dangerous actions. The left’s agenda is clear: destroy our values and our nation by corrupting our young.

We must act now to deradicalize Gen Z and restore sanity. The future of America, quite literally, depends on it.

Let’s take a stand together and **Save America Now**.

---
| | DOM JONES SẴN SÀNG HỖ TRỢ CỘNG ĐỒNG NGƯỜI VIỆT QUẬN ORANGE!
---
| | The path forward in our democracy is clear: we must elect leaders who embrace and celebrate every community as a vibrant thread in the rich tapestry of American diversity.
---
| | |
---
| | Dom Jones Makes a Personal Commitment to The Vietnamese Community
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | Dom Jones đưa ra cam kết cá nhân với cộng đồng người Việt
---
| | |
---
| | Dom Jones, known as "Hạnh" in the Vietnamese community—a name derived from "Hạnh Phúc" meaning happiness—has a life story deeply intertwined with the Vietnamese American community. As a teenager without a home, Dom found refuge and a sense of belonging among Vietnamese Americans and a family that helped nurture her when she had no one else. This connection grew stronger during her three years of missionary service within the Vietnamese community, both in Little Saigon and Vietnam, where she lived among them, spoke their language, and dedicated herself to uplifting their spirits. Dom’s heartfelt desire to see the Vietnamese community flourish is evident in her fluency in Vietnamese and her deep cultural understanding. Her passion led her to host a show on Pho Bolsa TV Network, where she continues to inspire and connect with viewers. Now, as a candidate for California State Assembly in Coastal Orange County, Dom is committed to making the needs, education, and resources of the Vietnamese community a top priority. Team Dom Jones stands for all people, embracing the rich diversity of Orange County. Dom’s journey, shaped by her close bond with the Vietnamese community, has molded her into a leader who embodies compassion, resilience, and dedication. Her mission is to ensure that every voice is heard, every community is uplifted, and that the beautiful tapestry of American diversity is celebrated and cherished. As the next Assemblywoman, Dom Jones is determined to blaze a trail for all, especially for the community that has given her so much.
---
| |
---
| | [](https://www.domjones.org/so/b7P3CkmUp/c?w=c4KBPjHE0jU4JAYk0gcfhd2hJrhND2ePDEBB5v6bkW4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZG9tam9uZXMub3JnL3NvL2I3UDNDa21VcD9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsInIiOiI5YjdhYTZjMS1kYjg0LTRkYjEtYTU5Zi01YzcyYmJjZjIyZjgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI1MWJiMTc0NC0yYTkzLTQzMGMtOGM0Ny0wODA2ODA2ZGQxYzIifQ)

| | Dom Jones, được biết đến với cái tên “Hạnh” trong cộng đồng người Việt—tên bắt nguồn từ “Hạnh Phúc” có nghĩa là hạnh phúc—có một câu chuyện cuộc đời gắn bó sâu sắc với cộng đồng người Mỹ gốc Việt. Là một thiếu niên không nhà, Dom tìm được nơi nương tựa và cảm giác thân thuộc giữa những người Mỹ gốc Việt và một gia đình đã giúp nuôi dưỡng cô khi cô không còn ai khác. Mối liên hệ này ngày càng bền chặt hơn trong ba năm cô phục vụ truyền giáo trong cộng đồng người Việt, cả ở Little Sài Gòn và Việt Nam, nơi cô sống giữa họ, nói ngôn ngữ của họ và cống hiến hết mình để nâng cao tinh thần của họ.Mong muốn chân thành của Dom được nhìn thấy cộng đồng người Việt phát triển được thể hiện rõ qua khả năng nói tiếng Việt thông thạo và hiểu biết sâu sắc về văn hóa của cô. Niềm đam mê đã khiến cô dẫn chương trình trên Pho Bolsa TV Network, nơi cô tiếp tục truyền cảm hứng và kết nối với người xem. Giờ đây, với tư cách là ứng cử viên cho Quốc hội Tiểu bang California ở Quận Cam ven biển, Dom cam kết đặt nhu cầu, giáo dục và nguồn lực của cộng đồng người Việt lên hàng đầu.Đội Dom Jones đại diện cho tất cả mọi người, đón nhận sự đa dạng phong phú của Quận Cam. Hành trình của Dom, được hình thành từ mối liên kết chặt chẽ của cô với cộng đồng người Việt, đã hun đúc cô thành một nhà lãnh đạo thể hiện lòng nhân ái, sự kiên cường và cống hiến. Sứ mệnh của cô là đảm bảo rằng mọi tiếng nói đều được lắng nghe, mọi cộng đồng đều được nâng cao và tấm thảm đẹp về sự đa dạng của nước Mỹ được tôn vinh và trân trọng. Với tư cách là Nữ nghị sĩ tiếp theo, Dom Jones quyết tâm mở đường cho tất cả mọi người, đặc biệt là cộng đồng đã cống hiến cho cô rất nhiều.

Sign up now to be a part of this incredible journey! | | Can't see this message? | | | | | | DOM JONES STANDS IN SUPPORT OF THE VIETNAMESE COMMUNITY OF ORANGE COUNTY! | | DOM JONES SẴN SÀNG HỖ TRỢ CỘNG ĐỒNG NGƯỜI VIỆT QUẬN ORANGE! | | The path forward in our democracy is clear: we must elect leaders who embrace and celebrate every community as a vibrant thread in the rich tapestry of American diversity. | | | | | Dom Jones Makes a Personal Commitment to The Vietnamese Community | | | | | | | Dom Jones đưa ra cam kết cá nhân với cộng đồng người Việt | | | | | Dom Jones, known as "Hạnh" in the Vietnamese community—a name derived from "Hạnh Phúc" meaning happiness—has a life story deeply intertwined with the Vietnamese American community. As a teenager without a home, Dom found refuge and a sense of belonging among Vietnamese Americans and a family that helped nurture her when she had no one else. This connection grew stronger during her three years of missionary service within the Vietnamese community, both in Little Saigon and Vietnam, where she lived among them, spoke their language, and dedicated herself to uplifting their spirits. Dom’s heartfelt desire to see the Vietnamese community flourish is evident in her fluency in Vietnamese and her deep cultural understanding. Her passion led her to host a show on Pho Bolsa TV Network, where she continues to inspire and connect with viewers. Now, as a candidate for California State Assembly in Coastal Orange County, Dom is committed to making the needs, education, and resources of the Vietnamese community a top priority. Team Dom Jones stands for all people, embracing the rich diversity of Orange County. Dom’s journey, shaped by her close bond with the Vietnamese community, has molded her into a leader who embodies compassion, resilience, and dedication. Her mission is to ensure that every voice is heard, every community is uplifted, and that the beautiful tapestry of American diversity is celebrated and cherished. As the next Assemblywoman, Dom Jones is determined to blaze a trail for all, especially for the community that has given her so much. | | | | | | Dom Jones, được biết đến với cái tên “Hạnh” trong cộng đồng người Việt—tên bắt nguồn từ “Hạnh Phúc” có nghĩa là hạnh phúc—có một câu chuyện cuộc đời gắn bó sâu sắc với cộng đồng người Mỹ gốc Việt. Là một thiếu niên không nhà, Dom tìm được nơi nương tựa và cảm giác thân thuộc giữa những người Mỹ gốc Việt và một gia đình đã giúp nuôi dưỡng cô khi cô không còn ai khác. Mối liên hệ này ngày càng bền chặt hơn trong ba năm cô phục vụ truyền giáo trong cộng đồng người Việt, cả ở Little Sài Gòn và Việt Nam, nơi cô sống giữa họ, nói ngôn ngữ của họ và cống hiến hết mình để nâng cao tinh thần của họ.Mong muốn chân thành của Dom được nhìn thấy cộng đồng người Việt phát triển được thể hiện rõ qua khả năng nói tiếng Việt thông thạo và hiểu biết sâu sắc về văn hóa của cô. Niềm đam mê đã khiến cô dẫn chương trình trên Pho Bolsa TV Network, nơi cô tiếp tục truyền cảm hứng và kết nối với người xem. Giờ đây, với tư cách là ứng cử viên cho Quốc hội Tiểu bang California ở Quận Cam ven biển, Dom cam kết đặt nhu cầu, giáo dục và nguồn lực của cộng đồng người Việt lên hàng đầu.Đội Dom Jones đại diện cho tất cả mọi người, đón nhận sự đa dạng phong phú của Quận Cam. Hành trình của Dom, được hình thành từ mối liên kết chặt chẽ của cô với cộng đồng người Việt, đã hun đúc cô thành một nhà lãnh đạo thể hiện lòng nhân ái, sự kiên cường và cống hiến. Sứ mệnh của cô là đảm bảo rằng mọi tiếng nói đều được lắng nghe, mọi cộng đồng đều được nâng cao và tấm thảm đẹp về sự đa dạng của nước Mỹ được tôn vinh và trân trọng. Với tư cách là Nữ nghị sĩ tiếp theo, Dom Jones quyết tâm mở đường cho tất cả mọi người, đặc biệt là cộng đồng đã cống hiến cho cô rất nhiều. | | | | | | | We're thrilled to invite young people and many more to join the parade of volunteers helping Dom Jones reach every community within Assembly District 72 of Orange County!Click the link below to sign up, and we'll contact you soon! name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Kari Lake’s remarks, and our path forward
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.

| Peter, Kari Lake directly addressed the Republican National Convention.

She had a prime-time slot, one of the biggest of the night. I’m not going to speculate on how many people watched, but I can tell you one thing for sure: It was the biggest platform she’s ever had.

We always knew that this would be one of the closest races in the country. That’s no secret. But we’ve been really fortunate so far because month after month we have absolutely crushed Kari Lake’s fundraising numbers. That gives us a tremendous advantage, and it lets us deliver our message to the people who need to hear it.

All that could change in an instant, though. The kind of national attention that Kari Lake got could turn into millions of dollars raised in the blink of an eye. Big donors send in massive checks, the millions of MAGA faithful add their donations, and before you know it we’re the ones getting crushed. It’s Kari Lake’s ads flooding the airwaves, and our chances at defending Arizona and holding the U.S. Senate collapse.

The only way we’ll prevent that from happening is if we continue to raise the resources we need to win.

I need you with me. It’s as simple as that.

name: Jill Stein
subject: Netanyahu is coming to Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Genociders and warmongers of a feather stick together

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warmongers&n=1)
---
* * *
---
Peter,

Benjamin Netanyahu should be headed to the Hague.

Instead he’s headed our way, where he can expect a warm and friendly, thoroughly bipartisan reception from his many many MANY friends in Washington D.C.

Netanyahu is slated to give a joint address to Congress, invited by both Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson and Democratic Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer.

He’s scheduled to meet with Biden, and reports say he’s ‘desperately seeking’ a sit down with Trump.

**Clearly, genociders and warmongers will always stick together.

** The Republican Party is currently trying to rebrand themselves as the party of isolationism, with speakers at this week’s convention calling for an end to “forever wars” (a longtime rallying cry of the activist left).

They are absurdly trying to portray Donald Trump – the man who called for Israel to “finish the job” in Gaza, who openly provoked all out war with Iran and threatened ‘fire and fury’ against North Korea – as a peacemaker.

Even Trump’s new VP pick, J.D. Vance, abandoned this pretense of isolationism just minutes after news broke of his nomination.

_"A lot of people recognize that we need to do something with Iran—but not these weak little bombing runs. If you're going to punch the Iranians, you punch them hard."
_**J.D. Vance on Sean Hannity, Monday, July 15th
** **
**And while the Democrats insist that only they stand between Republican warmongering and a peaceful, stable world – they are openly funding and arming a genocide and inviting a war criminal to an visit as an honored VIP.

**Let’s get real. There is only ONE choice on the ballot for a majority of voters with a decades-long record of anti-war activism; only one with the credibility to stand up to empire, dismantle the American war machine, and forge a path forward for people, planet, and peace.

[Millions of voters are now newly disillusioned by their choices from the twin parties of war and Wall Street. I need your help to reach them. Will you donate $25, $50, $100 or more today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warmongers&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warmongers&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=warmongers&n=3)
---
As long as Democrats and Republicans remain in power, America will always be in the throes of war.

But we don’t have to live this way.

The overwhelming majority of Americans yearn for peace. All people want is the chance to live a full and happy life and secure a livable future for their children.

That future is within our reach. We must refuse to accept anything less.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

I'm a proud mom of six (yes, six!) wonderful children, and I've spent my career fighting to make things just a little easier for hard-working Michigan families like mine.

I grew up in Portland, Michigan. My dad worked construction, often clocking in 70 to 80 hours a week. When the construction season slowed down and it got cold, he worked snow removal to make ends meet. Like many people in this district, Dad wasn't afraid to get calluses on his hands through a tough day’s work.

Through grit and hard work, my family was able to achieve what I call the Michigan Dream: to own a home, pay the bills, put a little away for retirement, and, every once in a while, have the chance to drive to Disney World. Thanks to my mom and dad, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college, and I have been working to uplift families like ours ever since.

I was elected to the Michigan State Senate, where I fight every day to support Michigan families and combat extremism. I led the charge to pass the largest tax cut for working families in Michigan's history. I introduced a plan to address the growing childcare crisis in our state. I've fought to protect abortion rights, and, in one of my first acts in the state Senate, passed a common-sense gun violence prevention bill.

Now, I'm running for Congress because the Michigan Dream is falling out of reach for too many families, and we need to pass solutions through the U.S. Congress that will help level the playing field. I will make sure we invest in our workers and create good-paying jobs right here in Michigan, protect abortion rights, and work to keep our kids safe from the epidemic of gun violence.

clean_body: Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and EMILYs List? | = = = | = I'm a proud mom of six (yes, six!) wonderful children, and I've spent my career fighting to make things just a little easier for hard-working Michigan families like mine. I grew up in Portland, Michigan. My dad worked construction, often clocking in 70 to 80 hours a week. When the construction season slowed down and it got cold, he worked snow removal to make ends meet. Like many people in this district, Dad wasn't afraid to get calluses on his hands through a tough day’s work. Through grit and hard work, my family was able to achieve what I call the Michigan Dream: to own a home, pay the bills, put a little away for retirement, and, every once in a while, have the chance to drive to Disney World. Thanks to my mom and dad, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college, and I have been working to uplift families like ours ever since. I was elected to the Michigan State Senate, where I fight every day to support Michigan families and combat extremism. I led the charge to pass the largest tax cut for working families in Michigan's history. I introduced a plan to address the growing childcare crisis in our state. I've fought to protect abortion rights, and, in one of my first acts in the state Senate, passed a common-sense gun violence prevention bill. Now, I'm running for Congress because the Michigan Dream is falling out of reach for too many families, and we need to pass solutions through the U.S. Congress that will help level the playing field. I will make sure we invest in our workers and create good-paying jobs right here in Michigan, protect abortion rights, and work to keep our kids safe from the epidemic of gun violence. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thanks, Kristen EMILYs List is a community of over five million members that helps elect Democratic pro-choice women to office. = = Paid for by EMILYs List and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. #
# **Over 160 Affordable Rental Units are Being Built in the 7th District!**
_Senator Hughes recently announced over $5.9M in affordable rental housing tax credits for 4 new projects, bringing the total neighborhood investment to over $75M_ Senator Vincent Hughes was proud to announce over $5.9M in [Low Income Housing Tax Credits](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168299.173026.576&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11505) for 4 rental housing projects in the 7th district. In total the projects will bring 163 affordable rental units, with 39 of those units being accessible units, a major win for low-income renters throughout the district. These tax credits bring the total neighborhood investment Senator Hughes has announced to over $75M. **" Affordable housing continues to be a fundamental need in communities across Philadelphia and Pennsylvania." ** **- Senator Hughes **
* * *
_4 New Affordable Rental Housing Projects are Coming to the 7th District_
* * *
**" These tax credits will allow us to provide more housing to renters and ensure our neighborhoods remain accessible to the folks who have lived there for decades. We must continue to make affordable housing a priority to enable more opportunity and upward progress in our neighborhoods." ** **- Senator Hughes** **** Affordable housing continues to be a major priority for Senator Hughes as he advocates for state investments and support as Democratic Appropriations Chair. In 2022, Senator Hughes and other Senate Democrats advocated for $65 million in [PHARE funds](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168299.173026.576&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11506) in addition to other budget increases for affordable housing investments. Their advocacy resulted in the largest increase in affordable housing investments in Pennsylvania's history. Just last week, Senator Hughes was proud to share that PHARE funding will be increased to $70M in the FY24-25 budget and continue to increase to up to $100M by FY27-28.
* * *
**" Pennsylvania has the resources to continue moving affordable housing forward in a major way. We were proud to secure increases for affordable housing in the FY24-25 budget but we also stay ready to fight for more to provide more high quality, safe, and accessible affordable housing in our neighborhoods." ** **- Senator Hughes**

The Republican National Convention was awfully similar to the Texas GOP’s gathering a few months earlier.
#
The Republican National Convention just ended. And if you’re feeling déjà vu, it might be because the extremist MAGA agenda adopted in Milwaukee sounds an awful lot like the radical platform adopted by Texas Republicans at their own convention back in May.
In Milwaukee, the Republican Party nominated JD Vance as its candidate for vice president. Vance is an extremist — even by modern Republican standards. He:
* Wants to ban abortion _even in cases of rape or incest,_ claiming that “two wrongs don’t make a right”
* Is a fan of Project 2025, which he says has _“good ideas”_
* Said that if he had been vice president in 2021, he would have _blocked the certification of Joe Biden’s victory_ on January 6th

JD Vance is a radical ideologue, with a political outlook that is incompatible with our democracy. And yet, his extreme ideas seem to have a home in the party of MAGA.
They’re certainly in line with those of the Texas Republican Party, which adopted its own radical agenda at the party convention in San Antonio a few months ago. As a reminder, the new Texas GOP platform:
* Would require instruction on the Bible in _all public schools_
* Proclaims that abortion is _“homicide”_ and criminalizes it accordingly
* Supports deporting _legal residents_ who participate in protests
* Violates the Voting Rights Act by requiring any candidate for statewide office to win a majority of counties — effectively _banning Democrats from the governorship_ and other statewide posts

From San Antonio to Milwaukee, the Republican Party continues to lurch towards extremism and authoritarianism. And from Austin to Washington, it is up to us to stop them from enacting their agenda.
Powered by People is reaching, registering, and mobilizing Democratic voters in every corner of Texas. We’re making sure that every Texan will have their voice heard in November. And we’re working to elect Democrats across the state — Democrats who will stand up to the state GOP’s un-American platform in Austin, and who will block national Republicans’ extreme agenda in Washington.
But we need your help to get it done.

body:
Experts have Arizona as one of the most likely states to flip. Polls have this race tied at best, and Kari Lake projected to win at worst — including one from just this week.
#

Peter, we’ve got to level with you today.
Things haven’t been going as well as we had hoped.
We were counting on the Republican National Convention — four days of extremism and noise from the MAGA right — to wake people up.

body:
Last night’s presidential debate between President Biden and Donald Trump highlighted the urgent issues facing America, particularly the care crisis and its economic impact.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89190522/486488566/664783965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGJjZmRhMi0xYTQ2LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jkWT3h6V7ioPIrO1ehieWd3rA7Eg9Q01rTY3XuyTNGQ=&emci=93d10b18-1146-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=edbcfda2-1a46-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
Just days ago, Donald Trump selected J.D. Vance as his vice presidential nominee.
**This ticket has an abysmal record on care and policies focused on women and families.**
As president, Trump’s administration **prioritized the ultra‐rich** and **left working families behind** — and his platform has no plan to address the affordability crisis or invest in child care, aging care, disability care, or paid leave.
J.D. Vance has **argued against universal child care** and **champions Project 2025** , which would eliminate critical programs and agencies for families like Head Start and the Department of Education.
[**_Can you join us as a Care in Action member to organize against this threat to care workers and families?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89190523/486488567/-886428516?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGJjZmRhMi0xYTQ2LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jkWT3h6V7ioPIrO1ehieWd3rA7Eg9Q01rTY3XuyTNGQ=&emci=93d10b18-1146-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=edbcfda2-1a46-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)

The Biden-Harris administration has consistently delivered for care workers and families, providing higher wages for care workers, making child care more affordable, and extending work permits to hundreds of thousands of undocumented spouses.
**The two visions for America could not be more different** — and only one will make sure no one has to make the impossible choices between work and family.
