clean_body: Last night’s presidential debate between President Biden and Donald Trump highlighted the urgent issues facing America, particularly the care crisis and its economic impact. Hi Peter, Just days ago, Donald Trump selected J.D. Vance as his vice presidential nominee. This ticket has an abysmal record on care and policies focused on women and families. As president, Trump’s administration prioritized the ultra‐rich and left working families behind — and his platform has no plan to address the affordability crisis or invest in child care, aging care, disability care, or paid leave. J.D. Vance has argued against universal child care and champions Project 2025 , which would eliminate critical programs and agencies for families like Head Start and the Department of Education. The Biden-Harris administration has consistently delivered for care workers and families, providing higher wages for care workers, making child care more affordable, and extending work permits to hundreds of thousands of undocumented spouses. The two visions for America could not be more different — and only one will make sure no one has to make the impossible choices between work and family. And Election Day is less than four months away, Peter. Thank you for your support, Care in Action

Make America Great Once Again. That was the [rallying cry](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJBrPQEWg5STtRFKQzbZzz1gIdEGqUi8FxhyEa91FAOTEdf7bSOkCbIIRCAI65Q-CaCMhm9rEkaJZ6rTDY44hJTAgXiXtvBH0CFi8xGgw4C4yE9Rm7B6vonTq4Vd4tTfWEVc7R5Ixk2d9OToJ20pmr3drjQNXb6ogrotFIdt6hm-Iqzcrcu_7rW15hupcbKhTeje8FYsEWC13O-_HtBBpO9DEQ8bUdwTbpYThccf2psRCItUzee4s5Ava5BU_U-rtvDydh2UKWAaGRb11xAapW39Z1HxVCJhViv4_F_Bl1jU62HP5yLl0mODwYyGGGfFZvg%3D%3D) at the Republican National Convention, and it carried more weight than ever before. I’m not usually one for pep rallies, but President Trump’s survival of a harrowing [assassination attempt](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJBrNHP_QQvUyCjLyivV1bKl2RM6dJe4g-nxw_FENroDj0K1y_hpjzYCNp8yInc4WYhMhvQQgPKuOs0KFUFoKtmsVOorrJGSUfODV2uCUN5hEgwzsm0H6pJDOKRG_ucBTQZHEjNK08w-_wBg3EP1UQ5feFcEh7h7QRtRvFKERqVXe1AHRpAc3KsmBNCf5BVb-vbyjcP4GrDQwESD-sZX8AN-nsLlbsdGAZvedg0shAiGA5eCHq0R2Gqqwj1KVSak-MvSktbSxGhOuB9tAQ0zkgPHHlF5Pkn2u21Q3DL677pooV_oYr-YjIDl1XrAelV1xqg%3D%3D) marked a seismic shift—not only for him but for the entire party. Heck, even some of his former rivals came out in strong support of him this week. To be honest, I can’t remember the last time Republicans were this united. There’s a lot of chatter about [Biden’s next move](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJNTrR-JN-ODY6aD1G4x1_0A71LwVCE4u1REET-1ZhLBM9KtVGBff0XSmyzeYfwfrOl3rus9_tu8-sXTxqN_HWGlJFs5uEHj_DEwPJS4yP8IqLLM0WlmpV7nkl-W_u3FG0jXxpd4MRd8OTY_aVguwdQcOjLwcu7meHJjs15JnWnqF2Mk9fiWIODUlZ1HSmV5g22nBwvAIAwiB1YkUwjxWPoehdPuSwK7VO5Oywq1NNHwE0bTrLBpp2aeAd0N65-wU_g%3D%3D) as pressure mounts for him to drop out of the race. Will he or won’t he? Frankly, I don’t think it’ll make a dadgum difference. The RNC was proof that conservatism is alive and well in America, and it’s time to usher in a new era of prosperity—together. Make America Wealthy Again. Make America Safe Again. Make America Strong Again. Those were the GOP’s themes of the week, and they get to the very heart of what we’re trying to achieve in November. I hear it whenever I’m door knocking across East Tennessee: people of all ages feel like the American dream is slipping through their fingers. Our sons and daughters can’t afford to buy their [first homes](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJCTNjTm2HjW5M-RSnCznznMvZCwqhQwuPnkRULiyMeuCZXlREak0ypZAKF715hGwLNuILghGW4AfZSXd35SGtPBShbbY-upqK4DouVAotEzMQwZg01Lot7CfvyLaf7QQsA5SDYxB4f6iNDGOXiB5nQ5uV58AztaYbYpfS137L-Da4FJ0Hh0F6Qk0TIpu4PurJnrY5-JuODYpoPGUB0yBrqRtMkMlx6gQJ4Ytyay2Kech9iTb9JGHkLurgoKZ5TFlVepnkrk7g6VzDernLBoQVJQ%3D), and [seniors](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJNfkn6ku8GtkzrgIKfP37utF945XMYuQefQ45z3kkgpS-P-JvQcMUY4FuZwFKprN-ItLtCAC3MEYxgPapqjXDYLoGj_rj_2It5-Di3CEkmWPQwcS23E-GtuHKukWjD8M1yT_3LyHZLYlKa2UcGlt1oA4VRrpv68uLMwrWsStdn2_KStiaEIGyfTOpDwsHmB5TNksaLUrN7YOnuKLd5np647JLznskVjIHtLR55pTj-_AKPc89XbZU4hJRtYEUke3_7a7n0Bx8jaYr8McuNI2TQ0%3D) can barely afford essentials at the grocery store. Veterans are sleeping on the [streets,](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJEFX6_kienwddPWRAMa2OMTfN3eE2uvSCDx9qqa-AnwwwBsyrNDez6lQkH0t5NEtTR0M6rEoypZ0g4vZxd-29Xg2tO6olJwPYNQkR2eDXNAsnGvU0dQ3yAUlR4uG-47FsvEVfPsg75UVgMHP9ENEUjqP4JAhGYJvbYzBGkmiVIw0SAZbpr_LP2xkBVKlm_AB9f8qE21OKWtQnCG0v0Mlx-dAtdimp49pVPlUx69XXq7oPYw4YPR_bv3xRr6EqyMjBw%3D%3D) but we're welcoming and housing illegal immigrants. We’re watching [wars and turmoil](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=268c77cbac634aa7b1942b6bbaccdaf7&_e=0rUFjpuynHn8_aKbMoINJLodh7uf8ac0vpzyF2RmHrLDFHkn13J4ybfNt2lE8SIIJ_Gd6fJRdPOPGNMkhlp_JiovRD95vVYEZmrH5IA6ODXSMEYxUqk3PB8vh0kEHMgW_wE5W9Tb8O7QGHiTK4u_AxDW4svBDPAZEceNSc2X0slEYaBB-unN6SA6ZFgr8RSXO2DRwRpTsIPwwGKa_sOkkgs4wL81Eadu64iW2DuPyYTIsDIc7KS1sHe61x63OzTEnicLlZjGlAvGc7JPaUnpjGAt6MZpKLqN8SJG1e50y8qHaxVtS4uaCHEA3gKerJYU) unfold across the globe, and our enemies are waiting in the wings because they know we’re vulnerable on the leadership front. All this to say, we’re living in scary times, but we have the power to change all this if we can win in a landslide up and down the ballot in November. What matters now is that we keep this palpable momentum going. We can’t get comfortable and assume we’ve got this thing in the bag—the race has just begun. Let’s restore the promise of America and fight for our future, for our families, and for our freedom. It’s our moment to make history, and if we can stay united, I believe we really can make America great once again.

“Why are Trump supporters spending big to elect Democrat Yassamin Ansari to Congress in a heavily Latino district? [...] nobody spends that kind of money without expecting something in return.”
Elvia Díaz, Arizona Republic
7/19/24
Peter,
In these last 11 days of the campaign, Super PACs largely funded by deep-pocketed MAGA donors are pouring in over $1 million to support our primary opponent to try and defeat our coalition. They have pledged millions of dollars to elect Donald Trump, and now they want to elect our opponent alongside him.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_071924_article [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_071924_article]
Because they know that Raquel and our coalition can’t be bought.

| Trump has made JD Vance his pick for Vice President. Here’s what we know about him:
* **Reproductive Rights:** JD Vance opposed codifying the right to contraception and was endorsed by an extremist group opposed to emergency contraception.

* **Social Security and Medicare:** He supported cuts to Medicare that would have increased costs for seniors.

| | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their beloved chocolate lab, Jasper.

This was already the most expensive Senate race in the country, and now, even more dark money is about to come pouring into Ohio to support my Trump-backed opponent, Bernie Moreno. 3. I urgently need your grassroots support if I’m going to win this race. Please, will you chip in $5 or more to split between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's to help us reach our $100,000 rapid-response goal by midnight so we can protect Ohio’s critical seat and keep the Senate blue? Thanks so much for your support, Sherrod

| | Peter, it’s 25-year Navy Captain and combat veteran Hung Cao. You might not know everything about my story, but by the end of this message, I hope you’ll take a leap of faith and join my Senate campaign today. I dedicated my life to serving our country. Ever since I was a little kid who had just come to America after escaping communism, I knew that this place was special. I deployed to some of the most dangerous war zones in the world during my Naval career. It was incredibly difficult - but it taught me that **America truly is the greatest nation on Earth.** _But right now, our greatest enemies aren_ _’_ _t foreign adversaries - they_ _’_ _re socialists and America-haters within our own country and our own government._ Washington DC insiders like Tim Kaine have put America last for too long. I won’t let it happen for one second longer. I’m not a career politician. I’m a veteran who stepped up because I LOVE this country too much to let it fall into the hands of selfish politicians who couldn’t care less about it. The Left is pouring millions into Tim Kaine’s bank accounts to try and silence me, and as much as I don’t like asking for help, I can’t face them alone and win. Last night at the RNC, former President Trump said the words we’ve been dreading: _“We will drill baby, drill.”_ And Trump didn’t just promise a fossil fuel boom — he also vowed to shut down any funding for a transition to green energy, calling it “a Green New scam.” This isn’t new. It’s a promise to enact the **_Project 2025,_** agenda, and it’s scarier than anything we’ve seen before. # Your Never-Ending Eversource or UI Bill - VOTE August 13th
### Illuminating the Shocking Subsidies hitting you this Summer - The Power is in your hands at the Ballot Box
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22ee0194-bb07-466e-ab3a-79576badaaac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0e12c0fd-d031-488f-8516-962e471f7789?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by [Riccardo Annandale](https://substack.com/redirect/83b52dfb-0bc6-483e-829f-e2c5e3b2f3a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/8b0497fc-1be3-4d42-b378-21227da60c9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I hope everyone is as excited about the November election as I am after a very different and humble message from President Trump as he accepted his endorsement.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8c564320-1381-4469-b10d-89df45966612?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Share Michael's Substack](https://substack.com/redirect/e2370a48-f831-4332-8961-3a5530a75585?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
While we will delve into that exceptional message another time, there is a pressing issue for Connecticut voters - **YOUR ENERGY BILLS.**
There was a time when the Bill had 2 lines - Supply Costs to make the energy and Transmission Costs to deliver it. I just got my bill and today there are 9 lines and the costs are skyrocketing. **You have to be an accountant to understand the bill:**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2fa1fb8d-9bbd-473c-9709-ad880b096224?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Source - Connecticut Office of Consumer Counsel](https://substack.com/redirect/1172c664-1a75-45dd-b3b6-14873c223d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
WHAT DOES THIS ALL MEAN? - There are 4 parts to this Never-ending bill: **Supply, Transmission, Local Delivery, and Public Benefits**.
* **Supply** \- this is the cost of energy generation - this is what it costs to make your power. In Connecticut, we rely on Nuclear and Natural Gas and our Energy Supply Costs are some of the highest in the Nation. If elected to Congress, I would fight to reduce regulation for mini nuclear power (**Our Cheapest and Greenest Energy**) and repeal the Jones Act for US Natural Gas - The windmills will not save Connecticut - [See a prior article on that.](https://substack.com/redirect/797ff147-d3fb-4e9a-a3a9-098bf5be9052?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**For this line item, according to Connecticut - Eversource and UI do not make a profit on this one.**_** **
* **Transmission -** This is regulated by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC). **If elected as your next Congressman, this is a federal issue where I could help to try to ease the pain**. For Transmission, Eversource and UI get a return on their investment to transmit the power to you.
* The **Local Delivery** \- This is your CT Government and the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) at work. Eversource and UI earn a return on their distribution investments which is authorized and regulated by PURA.
* The **Public Benefits** part of your bill is the kicker and is what you are charged for Eversource and UI to provide some things like grid reliability, affordability, clean energy and other mandates from Hartford. These are directly the result of bad energy policy due to a democrat controlled House and Senate.

**The last bucket does not benefit you but it might benefit your neighbor or others**. It is about 7 percent of your bill.
You may be asking Yourself - **WHAT IS THE PUBLIC BENEFIT AND AM I PART OF THE PUBLIC?**
These are effective taxes for you the hardworking Nutmegger to subsidize the utility companies and others who cannot afford to pay their bills and others who "go green" because they are told of the benefits. When they go green they are always sold the dream that equipment pays for itself. Well it pays for itself because you are paying and they are not. **The best part is you have no say in these takings and they are effectively government programs paid for with your after tax dollars.**
The System Benefits Charge is a subsidy where you are paying part of your electric bill to help people who cannot pay the bill (**which is a normal government assistance program that is administered by the government**). Connecticut has multiple programs that help those who cannot pay their bills and this is affecting a lot of every day Nutmeggers. A link to all these programs is listed in the most recent [Consumer Alert ](https://substack.com/redirect/eeaf3b99-8819-4ba6-8749-2787d2c60db1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from the CT OCC. While we have compassion for those who cannot pay their bills due to hardship, **this should be a function of the State and Federal Government**.
This sudden burden of forced charity could also be a result of an influx of illegals into Connecticut. You may be paying this because our Constitutional State is overwhelmed and outsourced this to you the tax payer to deal with. Or rather, they are imposing a taxation without representation.
**YES - Our Border Crisis is hitting CT and we are as much a border town as any other State. We must close the border and reverse the Biden/Himes curse.**
Another whammy to your bill is the Renewal Investment Charge. Essentially you, the taxpayer and now the billpayer, are making an investment that is run by CT to subsidize those who install renewable energy like solar panels. This is administered by the Connecticut Green Bank. They get panels and you pay.
The next shock to your wallet is the Conversion Adjustment Mechanism (CAM) charge. This is another conversion subsidy for your neighbors and an annual wealth transfer for about $160 million.
The final rate jolt in this "benefits" section is the Non-Bypassable Federally Mandated Conversion Charge (NBFMCC). This electric alphabet soup has initial renewable energy incentives at about 4.362 cents per KwH for Eversource and 2.7359 cents per KwH for UI.
Last I checked, you never thought you were going to be forced to help pay others bills or invest in a program where you do not see the benefit of it. Well you do and its called your taxes but this utility bill is not you W-2 or W-9 paycheck stub.
**While I object to this taking by the government, you should at least get a tax credit on your state and federal income tax.**_**While I work with your local state reps and senators to fight Hartford, I will be proposing that legislation in Congress to make the burden less shocking to your wallet.**_
The only way through this is sound energy policy for the US with the restoration of American Energy Independence, Micro-nuclear reactors to replace the nuclear dinosaurs in Connecticut and opening up new gas pipelines to Connecticut. **Your Utility Bill should not be the never-ending line item.**
**Demand Transparency and Accountability and this is why I am running for Congress.**
**This is why it is more important to make your voices heard at the ballot box this November and this August at the Primary. There are no excuses.** This is your fight to save your wallet, our democracy and our country and **the time is NOW**.
**IF YOU JUST GOT YOUR BILL - MAKE A NOTE TO GO AND VOTE ON AUGUST 13th. You have a pocketbook to save.**
Help me get through this primary so we can get to the people and retire Jim.
**MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.**
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.
Dr. Michael Goldstein
[www.goldsteinforcongress.com](https://substack.com/redirect/3c7179a8-419a-4989-9001-bcaec2862831?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

clean_body: Read Candidate Michael Goldstein's Thorough Analysis and Solution | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Read Candidate Michael Goldstein's Thorough Analysis and Solution | | | Jul 19 | | | | | | | | | | | | Jim Himes and the Democrats are unbelievable. It is almost as if they are deliberately trying to depopulate Connecticut. They are constantly plotting to rip off the citizenry with new scams to subsidize the corporations and bureaucracies. Eversource, UI and their CEOs are laughing all the way to the bank will we just pay and pay and pay. Read Mike Goldstein's analysis and see why we need a Congressman this intellectual caliber to protect our interests instead of the special interests. Your Never-Ending Eversource or UI Bill - VOTE August 13th Illuminating the Shocking Subsidies hitting you this Summer - The Power is in your hands at the Ballot Box | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Photo by on I hope everyone is as excited about the November election as I am after a very different and humble message from President Trump as he accepted his endorsement. While we will delve into that exceptional message another time, there is a pressing issue for Connecticut voters - YOUR ENERGY BILLS. There was a time when the Bill had 2 lines - Supply Costs to make the energy and Transmission Costs to deliver it. I just got my bill and today there are 9 lines and the costs are skyrocketing. You have to be an accountant to understand the bill: | | ---|---|--- WHAT DOES THIS ALL MEAN? - There are 4 parts to this Never-ending bill: Supply, Transmission, Local Delivery, and Public Benefits. Supply \- this is the cost of energy generation - this is what it costs to make your power. In Connecticut, we rely on Nuclear and Natural Gas and our Energy Supply Costs are some of the highest in the Nation. If elected to Congress, I would fight to reduce regulation for mini nuclear power (Our Cheapest and Greenest Energy) and repeal the Jones Act for US Natural Gas - The windmills will not save Connecticut - For this line item, according to Connecticut - Eversource and UI do not make a profit on this one. Transmission - This is regulated by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC). If elected as your next Congressman, this is a federal issue where I could help to try to ease the pain. For Transmission, Eversource and UI get a return on their investment to transmit the power to you. The Local Delivery \- This is your CT Government and the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) at work. Eversource and UI earn a return on their distribution investments which is authorized and regulated by PURA. The Public Benefits part of your bill is the kicker and is what you are charged for Eversource and UI to provide some things like grid reliability, affordability, clean energy and other mandates from Hartford. These are directly the result of bad energy policy due to a democrat controlled House and Senate. The last bucket does not benefit you but it might benefit your neighbor or others. It is about 7 percent of your bill. You may be asking Yourself - WHAT IS THE PUBLIC BENEFIT AND AM I PART OF THE PUBLIC? These are effective taxes for you the hardworking Nutmegger to subsidize the utility companies and others who cannot afford to pay their bills and others who "go green" because they are told of the benefits. When they go green they are always sold the dream that equipment pays for itself. Well it pays for itself because you are paying and they are not. The best part is you have no say in these takings and they are effectively government programs paid for with your after tax dollars. The System Benefits Charge is a subsidy where you are paying part of your electric bill to help people who cannot pay the bill (which is a normal government assistance program that is administered by the government). Connecticut has multiple programs that help those who cannot pay their bills and this is affecting a lot of every day Nutmeggers. A link to all these programs is listed in the most recent the CT OCC. While we have compassion for those who cannot pay their bills due to hardship, this should be a function of the State and Federal Government. This sudden burden of forced charity could also be a result of an influx of illegals into Connecticut. You may be paying this because our Constitutional State is overwhelmed and outsourced this to you the tax payer to deal with. Or rather, they are imposing a taxation without representation. YES - Our Border Crisis is hitting CT and we are as much a border town as any other State. We must close the border and reverse the Biden/Himes curse. Another whammy to your bill is the Renewal Investment Charge. Essentially you, the taxpayer and now the billpayer, are making an investment that is run by CT to subsidize those who install renewable energy like solar panels. This is administered by the Connecticut Green Bank. They get panels and you pay. The next shock to your wallet is the Conversion Adjustment Mechanism (CAM) charge. This is another conversion subsidy for your neighbors and an annual wealth transfer for about $160 million. The final rate jolt in this "benefits" section is the Non-Bypassable Federally Mandated Conversion Charge (NBFMCC). This electric alphabet soup has initial renewable energy incentives at about 4.362 cents per KwH for Eversource and 2.7359 cents per KwH for UI. Last I checked, you never thought you were going to be forced to help pay others bills or invest in a program where you do not see the benefit of it. Well you do and its called your taxes but this utility bill is not you W-2 or W-9 paycheck stub. While I object to this taking by the government, you should at least get a tax credit on your state and federal income tax.While I work with your local state reps and senators to fight Hartford, I will be proposing that legislation in Congress to make the burden less shocking to your wallet. The only way through this is sound energy policy for the US with the restoration of American Energy Independence, Micro-nuclear reactors to replace the nuclear dinosaurs in Connecticut and opening up new gas pipelines to Connecticut. Your Utility Bill should not be the never-ending line item. Demand Transparency and Accountability and this is why I am running for Congress. This is why it is more important to make your voices heard at the ballot box this November and this August at the Primary. There are no excuses. This is your fight to save your wallet, our democracy and our country and the time is NOW. IF YOU JUST GOT YOUR BILL - MAKE A NOTE TO GO AND VOTE ON AUGUST 13th. You have a pocketbook to save. Help me get through this primary so we can get to the people and retire Jim. MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS. Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on. Thank you for your continued support. Dr. Michael Goldstein Paid for by Goldstein for Congress | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Joseph Bentivegna 541 Cromwell Avenue, Rocky Hill, CT 06067 ? ?

| | Dear Fellow American,Adam Schiff just held a fundraiser in California with other elitist Democrat candidates. They hob-knobbed at a brunch in LA to fund their campaigns that will further destroy California and our country as we know it._And they raised over $700,000 dollars._ But how Adam Schiff runs his campaign now says a lot about how he will operate if he beats me. * Marjorie Taylor Greene delivered a divisive speech filled with lies.

* Convention speakers advocated for fewer rights for women and LGBTQ+ people, undermining democracy and abolishing labor and environmental protections.

Trump and his MAGA allies are rallying their base and uniting behind Project 2025, an agenda that would take our country backward. The wall-to-wall media coverage will boost Trump’s campaign and be a massive fundraising moment for Republicans. Even Elon Musk has pledged to donate $45 million to a Trump-aligned PAC EVERY MONTH until election day.

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: These past few weeks have been a lot.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
These past few weeks have been challenging, to say the least. We’re all grappling with a lot—in Texas and across the country. Here in Houston, we are on the other side of Hurricane Beryl, but people across our community are still struggling, trying to recover. Some people here are still without power in a brutal heat, some are losing power again, and just about everyone is worried about what might happen next time.
With all that going on, last weekend was 713 Day—July 13—a day dedicated to celebrating all things Houston and what makes our hometown so great, marked by our first of our many area codes, 713. I know no one would put summer weather on the list of those things that make the 713, the 281, the 832, and the 346 great. But what we have seen after the storm—true to form—is that the people who live here, who are helping each other through yet another disaster, are what makes this town one to love. I am so proud to represent this community in Congress.
And these recent weeks have also reminded us how important the work we do in Congress is—from funding flood mitigation efforts to tackling climate change and everything in between.
Which brings me back to how important it is to elect people who will take their jobs seriously, move our country forward, and be there for our communities in times of crisis. Hurricane Beryl made clear again how lucky and grateful I am to work with incredible partners across the city, county, state, and federal government—many of whom this group has helped elect.
We all have elections on our minds these days. November will be here before we know it. And this week’s Republican National Convention made clearer the stakes in the election. We have seen the transformation of the Republican Party into the Party of Trump. We see it clearly in the nominee for Vice President, JD Vance. Someone who once called Trump “noxious” and potentially “America’s Hitler” is now his running mate. And the blueprint for the next four years is laid out in Project 2025. You’ll hear more from me and others about Project 2025 because we all need to know what the Trump-Vance campaign plans to do if they win in November.
Read More About Project 2025 Here [https://joebiden.com/project2025/]
It’s a dystopian vision for the future of our country. But it doesn’t have to be that way. That’s where we come in. I believe now more than ever that we can win the White House, hold the Senate, and take back the House in November. I do. But I know we can only do that if we all work together. If we spread the word about what Project 2025 means for our country. And if we work together to win this race in #TX07 and to elect Democrats around the state and across the country.
If these last few weeks have shown us anything, it is how important it is that we come together—across our community, our state, and our country—to do the work that needs to be done. Thanks for all you do. Let’s keep it going from now to November.
Together, we can do anything,
LizzieSignature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]
